dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the world's largest markets, and hardware-software co-design across model, software and hardware layers yields multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理将成为全球最大的市场之一，模型、软件、硬件三层的软硬件协同设计能带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Memory bandwidth, not raw bits, is the key bottleneck; reasoning models and agentic workflows drive a multi-year memory shortage and rising CPU demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 真正的瓶颈是内存带宽而非位宽；推理模型与智能体式工作流造成多年内存短缺，并推高 CPU 需求。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is centralizing at frontier labs; labs' revenue per megawatt is soaring, letting them self-fund and shift more compute to training and R&D.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力正快速向少数前沿模型实验室集中；实验室每兆瓦收入飙升，使其能自我造血并把更多算力投向训练与研发。

dylanpatel.en: AI capex is already ~5-6% of US GDP and must decelerate by late next year due to capital and organizational constraints, not demand.
dylanpatel.zh: AI 资本开支已约占美国 GDP 的 5-6%，受资本与组织约束，明年底前增速必然放缓，而非需求见顶。

dylanpatel.en: AI spend is leveling into steady state as persistent agents become coworkers; value capture shifts from hardware toward labs, while open-source narrows the external gap.
dylanpatel.zh: 随着持久化智能体成为同事，AI 支出进入稳态；价值捕获从硬件转向实验室，开源在外部缩小差距但内部差距仍在。

diogoalmeida.en: Early on, he argues most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop and plausible-but-wrong outputs.
diogoalmeida.zh: 早期他就指出，多数大模型是为人类在环的辅助而非可靠自动化优化的；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩，输出看似合理却常常错误。

diogoalmeida.en: He insists data and the right task matter more than compute, rejecting the bitter lesson; scaling laws work only when data and task are right.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他坚持数据与选对任务比算力更重要，反驳“苦涩教训”；缩放定律只有在数据和任务正确时才成立。

diogoalmeida.en: Reliability, not speed, cost, or benchmark scores, becomes his central bottleneck; he calls intelligence per dollar the key metric.
diogoalmeida.zh: 可靠性而非速度、成本或基准分数成为他的核心瓶颈；他把“每美元智能”称为关键指标。

diogoalmeida.en: He deepens this into Jev: a natural-language plus state-machine primitive, a decision model exposing calibrated probabilities, not a chatbot.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他把这一思路深化为 Jev：自然语言加状态机的原语，一个暴露校准概率的决策模型，而非聊天机器人。

diogoalmeida.en: Later he broadens to safety: ASI, biorisk and cyber are distinct threat models; current models lack real autonomy and are breakthroughs away from true agency.
diogoalmeida.zh: 后期他扩展到安全议题：超级智能、生物风险与网络风险是不同威胁模型；当前模型缺乏真正自主性，距离真正的智能体还差若干突破。

jaderberg.en: Drug design needs general models like AlphaFold 3, not per-target local models; RL and agents explore vast chemical space.
jaderberg.zh: 2025 年，他强调药物设计需要像 AlphaFold 3 这样的通用模型，而非针对每个靶点的局部模型；强化学习与智能体用于探索巨大的化学空间。

jaderberg.en: Biology isn't data-constrained; historical data wasn't made for ML, and hiring ML experts without biology is an asset.
jaderberg.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续认为生物学并非受数据限制，历史数据并非为机器学习而生，招聘没有生物学背景的机器学习专家反而是优势。

jaderberg.en: AlphaFold proved deep learning generalizes in biology, justifying a company to solve all diseases via general, disease-agnostic models.
jaderberg.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AlphaFold 证明深度学习在生物学中可泛化，这支撑了用通用、疾病无关的模型解决所有疾病的公司使命。

jaderberg.en: Shift drug discovery from empirical to predictive computer-driven design; model human clinical toxicity before patients, not just target binding.
jaderberg.zh: 2026 年，他主张把药物发现从经验驱动转为预测性、计算机驱动的设计；在患者之前建模人体临床毒性，而不只是靶点结合。

jaderberg.en: Data, not models or compute, is the real bottleneck; generate proprietary data and use world models to bring the real world onto computers.
jaderberg.zh: 2026 年，他深化为：真正的瓶颈是数据而非模型或算力；应生成专有数据，并用世界模型把真实世界搬上计算机，减少实验。

brendanfoody.en: RL environments, not crowdsourced behavior cloning, are the new frontier for post-training; humans build verifiers and rubrics.
brendanfoody.zh: 2026 年，他把后训练的前沿从众包行为克隆转向强化学习环境，强调人类在多数领域仍是构建验证器与评分标准的关键。

brendanfoody.en: Data, not algorithms, drives model differentiation; building evals is the real bottleneck because RL saturates them fast.
brendanfoody.zh: 到 2026 年，他明确模型差异几乎全部来自数据而非算法，真正的瓶颈是为一切构建评估，因为强化学习会迅速把评估刷满。

brendanfoody.en: Models cannot reliably grade their own work; recursive self-improvement is limited in non-verifiable domains, so eval data must stay human.
brendanfoody.zh: 他持续反对模型给自己打分：在不可验证领域递归自我改进有限，因此评估数据必须由人类产生，合成数据只适合训练。

brendanfoody.en: Training agents becomes the last human job; every Fortune 500 builds a sovereign AI stack on proprietary data.
brendanfoody.zh: 他进一步把人类角色定位为训练智能体这一最后的工作，并预言每家财富 500 强都会用私有数据搭建自主 AI 栈。

brendanfoody.en: The bottleneck is not compute or algorithms but high-quality data and evals; long-horizon RL environments and virtual co-workers come next.
brendanfoody.zh: 最近他收束主线：瓶颈不是算力或算法而是高质量数据与评估，下一步是超长时程强化学习环境与虚拟同事。

elon.en: First principles thinking and full reusability are the core engineering method; production, not prototyping, is the real bottleneck.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调第一性原理思维与完全可复用是工程核心方法，并指出量产而非原型才是真正的瓶颈。

elon.en: AI safety shifts from regulation to truth-seeking; Neuralink aims at human-AI symbiosis, and population collapse becomes a civilizational threat.
elon.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，AI 安全从依赖监管转向要求 AI 追求真理；Neuralink 指向人机共生，人口崩溃被视为文明威胁。

elon.en: The intelligence big bang arrives: digital superintelligence may come within a year, with 10-20% annihilation risk but 80-90% great outcome.
elon.zh: 2025 年，他宣称智能大爆炸已至：数字超级智能可能一年内出现，10-20% 毁灭风险，但 80-90% 是好结果。

elon.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall, pushing AI compute and inference to space; Optimus enables recursive manufacturing and AI-driven abundance.
elon.zh: 2026 年，Scaling 撞上地球电力墙，AI 算力与推理转向太空；Optimus 实现递归制造，AI 驱动丰裕时代。

elon.en: Multiplanetary life and rigorous truth-seeking remain constants; he now doubts humans can control superintelligence, trusting peer review over regulation.
elon.zh: 贯穿始终的是多行星文明与严格追求真理；但他如今怀疑人类能否控制超级智能，更信任同行评审而非监管。

amjadmasad.en: AI coding tools make software creation accessible, but coders still needed for systems and debugging; tokens complement human capital.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 编程工具让软件开发触手可及，但理解系统和调试仍需要程序员；token 补充而非取代人力资本。

amjadmasad.en: Vibe coding emerged from users already 50-60% AI-assisted; Replit's moat is deep systems engineering, not just models.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他指出氛围编程并非突然出现，用户此前已获 50-60%的 AI 辅助；Replit 的护城河是深度系统工程，而非仅靠模型。

amjadmasad.en: Specialized decision models beat general agents on control, cost, safety; companies must own their intelligence and avoid vendor lock-in.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他主张专用决策模型在可控性、成本和安全性上优于通用智能体；企业必须拥有自己的智能并避免供应商锁定。

amjadmasad.en: AI doomerism is commercial EA language; no good argument AI kills everyone; foundation models commoditizing, focus on applications.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他批评 AI 末日论是商业化的有效利他主义话术，认为没有 AI 杀死所有人的好论证；基础模型正在商品化，应聚焦应用。

amjadmasad.en: Next vision is self-driving company via AI agents; trust and adaptability key; young people should explore, not prematurely optimize.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他提出下一个愿景是通过 AI 智能体实现自驱动公司；信任与适应力是关键；年轻人应探索而非过早优化。

vladtenev.en: Agentic trading has clear product-market fit; a large share of volume will come from agents while most assets stay long-term holdings.
vladtenev.zh: 智能体式交易已有明确的产品市场契合：个人交易量将有相当大比例来自智能体，而多数资产仍是长期持有。

vladtenev.en: The edge is not a shared model but different data, tools, and strategies across asset classes; giving everyone a powerful trading AI does not erase it.
vladtenev.zh: 优势不在共享模型，而在跨资产类别的不同数据、工具与策略；给每个人强大的交易 AI 本身并不会抹平这种优势。

vladtenev.en: AI is too centralized; labs keeping the strongest models in-house and monopolizing math and science discoveries is a dystopian, worse future.
vladtenev.zh: AI 过于中心化；实验室把最强模型留在内部、垄断数学与科学发现，是一种反乌托邦式的更糟未来。

vladtenev.en: Ownership is the path to financial freedom and societal stability; tokenization extends it globally so anyone with a smartphone can access US markets.
vladtenev.zh: 所有权是通往财务自由与社会稳定的路径；代币化把它扩展到全球，让任何有智能手机的人都能进入美国市场。

vladtenev.en: Accredited investor rules are outdated; restricting private company investments while allowing memecoins is irrational from a pure risk perspective.
vladtenev.zh: 合格投资者规则已经过时；从纯风险角度看，限制私人公司投资却允许模因币是不理性的。

shawnwang.en: Coding agents will break containment in 2026, moving beyond code to everything else; the next frontier is zero human review, not just zero human-written code.
shawnwang.zh: 2026 年，编程智能体将突破遏制，从代码扩展到其他一切领域；下一个前沿是零人工审查，而不仅仅是零人类编写的代码。

shawnwang.en: Context length is the slowest scaling factor; memory is the biggest limiting constraint, and scaling beyond 10 trillion parameters is temporary.
shawnwang.zh: 上下文窗口是扩展最慢的因素；记忆是最大的限制约束，而超过 10 万亿参数的 Scaling（规模扩张）是暂时的。

shawnwang.en: Open models are gaining market share despite a possible growing capability gap with closed models; fine-tuning services are becoming viable.
shawnwang.zh: 尽管与闭源模型的能力差距可能扩大，开源模型仍在获得市场份额；微调服务正变得可行。

shawnwang.en: Mid-tier SaaS is doomed as coding agents enable cloning and customization; SMBs enter a golden age with custom software for an audience of one.
shawnwang.zh: 随着编程智能体实现克隆和定制，中型 SaaS 注定消亡；中小企业进入黄金时代，可为单一受众定制软件。

shawnwang.en: AI engineer is a real discipline: engineers build harnesses around models; learning in public and persistent judgment-driven work beat credentialism.
shawnwang.zh: AI 工程师是一门真正的学科：工程师围绕模型构建工具链；公开学习和持续判断驱动的工作胜过资历主义。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula; RLHF turned GPT-4 into ChatGPT, and scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 预训练加强化学习是核心公式；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）把 GPT-4 变成 ChatGPT，而 Scaling 强化学习比 Scaling 预训练更难。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, yet generalization and self-correction remain missing; continual learning is needed for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling 预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与自我纠错仍缺失；通往 AGI（通用人工智能）需要持续学习。

tworek.en: Transformers are not the end state; architecture, not scaling laws, is now the key bottleneck for continual learning and test-time adaptation.
tworek.zh: Transformer 不是终点；如今架构而非缩放定律，才是持续学习与测试时适应的关键瓶颈。

tworek.en: Large-scale RL stays necessary for AGI, but RL is inefficient and not the only way to learn from experience; end-to-end pre-training plus RL is needed.
tworek.zh: 大规模强化学习仍是 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要元素，但强化学习低效且并非从经验中学习的唯一方式；需要预训练与强化学习端到端结合。

tworek.en: Frontier progress will come from small teams using capable agents; alignment is unsolved, and a post-labor society may center on learning.
tworek.zh: 前沿进展将来自使用强能力智能体的小团队；对齐尚未解决，后劳动社会可能以学习为中心。

richardsocher.en: Superintelligence should excite us most for science, not job loss; recursive self-improvement is inevitable because AI can code, but slow takeoff is real.
richardsocher.zh: 超级智能最该让我们兴奋的是科学，而不是失业；递归式自我改进不可避免，因为 AI 会写代码，但慢起飞是真实的。

richardsocher.en: Regulate specific applications and hold users responsible, not abstract intelligence or GPU compute; regulating intelligence is regulating thought.
richardsocher.zh: 应监管具体应用并让使用者负责，而非监管抽象智能或 GPU 算力；监管智能就是监管思想。

richardsocher.en: The next automation frontier is AI research itself; the Eureka machine rests on world knowledge, measurement data, simulations, and robotic experiments.
richardsocher.zh: 下一个自动化前沿是 AI 研究本身；尤里卡机器建立在世界知识、测量数据、仿真与机器人实验四根支柱上。

richardsocher.en: World models are overrated; language models have far more room to grow, and language is the key to human intelligence and civilization.
richardsocher.zh: 世界模型被高估了；语言模型还有大得多的成长空间，而语言是人类智能与文明的关键。

richardsocher.en: Open source and open weights are safer: more good actors with diverse AI beats concentrating power; hard takeoff and paperclip scenarios are overblown.
richardsocher.zh: 开源与开放权重更安全：更多善意的参与者拥有多样化的 AI 胜过权力集中；硬起飞与回形针场景被夸大了。

erikbernhardsson.en: GPU scarcity is real but not absolute: pay more, commit longer, look across 25+ clouds; the worst part is capacity sold as three-year rectangles.
erikbernhardsson.zh: GPU 稀缺是真的但不绝对：多付钱、签更长合约、跨 25+ 云找容量；最糟的不是拿不到卡，而是容量被切成三年期矩形合约出售。

erikbernhardsson.en: Inference is the next cloud-sized market; selling tokens alone races to the bottom, so a multi-product platform of post-training, sandboxes and agentic tools creates durable switching costs.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 推理是下一个云级市场；只卖 token 是价格战，后训练、沙盒与智能体工具组成的多产品平台才带来持久转换成本。

erikbernhardsson.en: Infrastructure alpha comes from rebuilding the stack—own file system, container runtime, scheduler—not wrapping Kubernetes; CUDA is not the moat.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 基础设施的 alpha 来自重造技术栈——自研文件系统、容器运行时、调度器——而非包一层 Kubernetes；CUDA 不是护城河。

erikbernhardsson.en: Open source is good enough off the shelf, so fine-tuning is no longer mandatory; we contribute to vLLM and SGLang while keeping infra alpha proprietary.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 开源模型开箱即用已足够好，微调不再是必需；我们回馈 vLLM 与 SGLang，但把基础设施 alpha 保持专有。

erikbernhardsson.en: Agents shift leverage to senior engineers and entrench incumbents trained on old code; my prior view that GPU rental prices would fall has reversed—they will rise over 12 months.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 智能体把杠杆交给资深工程师，并让基于旧代码训练的现有厂商更稳固；我此前认为 GPU 租金会跌，现已反转——未来 12 个月会涨。

altman.en: Early framing: cut cognitive load, explore cheaply, then commit hard; AGI will lower the premium on raw human intelligence.
altman.zh: 早期框架：减少认知负荷、低成本广泛探索后再果断聚焦；他当时就预判 AGI（通用人工智能）会降低人类智力的溢价。

altman.en: RLHF made models usable; alignment and capability are linked, so deploy iteratively and let society adapt.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）让模型真正可用；对齐与能力相互促进，因此要迭代部署、让社会同步适应。

altman.en: Scaling keeps delivering; compute becomes the key bottleneck, while agentic AI and safety-by-deployment take center stage.
altman.zh: 2024 到 2025 年：Scaling（规模扩张）持续见效，算力成为核心瓶颈；智能体式 AI 与“在部署中做安全”成为主线。

altman.en: AGI becomes a gradient and a marketing term; the goal shifts to a continuous ramp toward superintelligence with humans in control.
altman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年：AGI（通用人工智能）被重新定义为渐变过程乃至营销词，目标转向持续攀升的超级智能，但强调人类必须保持控制。

altman.en: Alignment is not solved and may get harder; he now accepts pausing training and warns that concentrated power is as dangerous as loss of control.
altman.zh: 2026 年：明确承认对齐尚未解决、甚至可能更难，愿意为安全暂停训练；并把权力过度集中与控制权丧失并列为两大风险——这是对早期乐观的深化与修正。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste, voice, and judgment matter more as AI commoditizes quality, and the talent pipeline is breaking.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 视为通用技术：当 AI 让质量变得同质化，人类的品味、声音与判断力反而更值钱，而人才梯队正在断裂。

ethanmollick.en: We have entered the agentic era: AI runs long tasks independently, the bottleneck shifts from capability to interface, and delegation erodes the expertise needed to judge output.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年，他宣告进入智能体时代：AI 独立执行长任务，瓶颈从能力转向界面，而委托任务会侵蚀判断输出所需的专业能力。

ethanmollick.en: AI's exponential curve and jagged frontier persist; more AI creates more human work by lowering organizing costs, so workflows must augment rather than automate.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年，他坚持 AI 的指数曲线与锯齿状前沿：AI 越多，组织成本越低、人类工作反而越多，因此流程应增强而非单纯自动化。

ethanmollick.en: Use AI as a tutor that challenges you, not an answer machine; give it harder tasks, since most people underestimate current models.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年，他反复强调把 AI 当会挑战你的导师而非答案机，并给它更难的任务，因为多数人低估了现有模型。

ethanmollick.en: The internal-public frontier gap is widening, ending iterative deployment; prompting tricks like chain of thought and personas no longer help, so just ask directly.
ethanmollick.zh: 到 2026 年末，他进一步指出内部与公开前沿模型的差距在扩大、迭代部署终结；思维链与人格化提示技巧已失效，直接提问即可。

jeetupatel.en: AI shifts are megatrends you ride, not fight; Cisco's role is picks and shovels for AI infrastructure, networking, security, and silicon.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 视为不可对抗的巨型趋势，主张顺势而为；Cisco 的定位是 AI 基础设施的“卖铲人”，覆盖网络、安全与芯片。

jeetupatel.en: Only ~2% agent adoption amid severe supply constraints; there is no AI infrastructure overbuild because demand consumes supply instantly.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年，他指出智能体采用率仅约 2%，AI 基础设施严重供不应求；所谓“过度建设”并不存在，因为需求会瞬间吞掉供给。

jeetupatel.en: AI creates more engineering jobs, not fewer; not using AI makes you less safe as attacks happen at machine scale.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地认为 AI 会创造更多工程岗位而非减少；不用 AI 反而更不安全，因为攻击已以机器规模发生。

jeetupatel.en: Use AI to learn faster, not to outsource learning; don't fully delegate, since skipping the reps erodes instinct.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 应用来加速学习而非外包学习；不应完全委托给 AI，跳过练习会侵蚀直觉，过程与练习比结果更重要。

jeetupatel.en: Leaders must be paranoid but not panicked, responsive but not reactive; present AI upside and risks evenly rather than doom narratives.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年，他对领导力的主张深化为：保持偏执但不恐慌、响应但不反应过度；对 AI 应均衡呈现收益与风险，而非渲染末日叙事。

sundarpichai.en: AI investment is redefining every Alphabet business; Gemini integrated across Search, Cloud, YouTube drives 24% revenue growth and record Cloud backlog.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，AI 投资正重新定义 Alphabet 各项业务；Gemini 深度整合进搜索、云与 YouTube，带来 24% 营收增长与创纪录云订单。

sundarpichai.en: Compute is allocated first to frontier AGI research, then core products; cloud forgoes short-term revenue to support the frontier.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，算力优先分配给前沿 AGI（通用人工智能）研究，其次才是核心产品；云业务为支持前沿而放弃短期收入。

sundarpichai.en: Safety needs defense in depth: alignment, real-time monitoring, sandboxing and independent evaluators; trust is a differentiator for consumer agents.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，安全需要纵深防御：对齐、实时监控、沙箱与独立评估者；信任是消费级智能体规模化的差异化优势。

sundarpichai.en: World models matter alongside LLMs for AGI; recursive self-improvement today keeps AI researchers in the loop, not a fully autonomous explosion.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，通往 AGI（通用人工智能）不只靠大模型，世界模型同样关键；当下的递归自我改进仍把 AI 研究者留在回路中，而非完全自主的智能爆炸。

sundarpichai.en: Agentic AI is additive to Search and ads, creating new commercial intent; TPU sales to third parties and 2027 productivity gains follow.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索与广告是增量，创造新的商业意图；向第三方出售 TPU 系统，并预期 2027 年迎来生产力黄金期。

marvinschwaibold.en: AI tools amplify rather than replace creativity, letting designers prototype and iterate independently; curiosity and hands-on experimentation keep designers relevant.
marvinschwaibold.zh: AI 工具放大而非取代创造力，让设计师能独立做原型、快速迭代；好奇心与亲手实验让设计师保持相关性。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers shift from executors to editors: AI handles execution while humans curate, set the bar, and supply judgment AI lacks.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 设计师从执行者转为编辑者：AI 负责执行，人类负责策展、设定标准，并提供 AI 所缺的判断力。

marvinschwaibold.en: AI-built prototypes persuade faster than PRD documents; designers should break tasks into subtasks and feed them iteratively to AI agents.
marvinschwaibold.zh: AI 做出的原型比 PRD 文档更有说服力；设计师应把任务拆成子任务，迭代地喂给智能体。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers should build and test in code, even commit pull requests, not just design in Figma; the limiting factor becomes ideas, not execution speed.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 设计师应写代码、做测试甚至提交 pull request，而不只在 Figma 里设计；瓶颈从执行速度变成想法本身。

marvinschwaibold.en: Curation and human craft matter more as AI generates more: less is more, show top features clearly, and favor native scroll over scroll-jacking.
marvinschwaibold.zh: AI 生成越多，策展与人工打磨越重要：少即是多，清晰呈现核心功能，用原生滚动而非滚动劫持。

ariweinstein.en: Computer use has crossed from demo to superhuman speed, and the bottleneck is now website load time, not model intelligence.
ariweinstein.zh: 到 2026 年，computer use 已从演示跨入超人速度，瓶颈不再是模型智能，而是网站加载时间。

ariweinstein.en: Agents now use any human-designed software via accessibility trees and DOM, not screenshot loops, completing the dev lifecycle.
ariweinstein.zh: 2026 年，智能体通过无障碍树和 DOM 而非截图循环使用任何人类设计的软件，并完成整个开发周期。

ariweinstein.en: The scaling moment for computer use has arrived in consumer and enterprise at once, with proactivity and deterministic controls as adoption keys.
ariweinstein.zh: computer use 的 Scaling（规模扩张）时刻在消费端与企业端同时到来，主动性与确定性控制成为落地的关键。

ariweinstein.en: Trust has shifted: people let agents configure DNS and pay bills, so sandboxing and human-in-the-loop dials matter more than raw capability.
ariweinstein.zh: 信任已发生转变：人们让智能体配置 DNS、支付账单，因此沙箱与人类在环控制比原始能力更重要。

ariweinstein.en: Legacy software and UI won't vanish; computer use coexists with them, and startups keep a moat in deep industry workflows labs overlook.
ariweinstein.zh: 传统软件与 UI 不会消失；computer use 与之共存，初创公司在实验室忽视的深度行业工作流上仍有护城河。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and smooth, but alignment and values do not emerge automatically from Scaling（规模扩张）; safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律、我们并不真正理解其平滑性，能力涌现不可预测，而对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动出现，安全研究必须依托前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent (~3% understood) yet crucial; post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training; AGI is a smooth curve, not a point.
dario.zh: 2024 年他把重心转向可解释性——坦言只理解约 3%，同时提出后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）已与预训练同等重要，并坚持 AGI（通用人工智能）是平滑曲线而非单点。

dario.en: Capabilities double every few months; safety and capabilities are intertwined; the real risk is overheating, not slowing down; AGI as a term is meaningless.
dario.zh: 2025 年他强化指数叙事：能力每几个月翻倍，安全与能力不可分割，最大风险是过热而非减速，并开始认为 AGI（通用人工智能）这个词本身已无意义，应看实际能力。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses' may arrive in 1-3 years; mechanistic interpretability and layered safeguards must ratchet up with capability.
dario.zh: 2026 年他称已接近指数曲线的末端，'数据中心里的天才之国'可能 1-3 年到来；主线深化为机制可解释性加分层防护随能力同步收紧，并强调放缓与对华谈判是可行的。

dario.en: A consistent thread: exponential progress is real, safety must be built alongside capability, and decentralized competition beats a single mandated constitution.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：指数级进步真实存在，安全必须与能力同步建设，而分散竞争优于自上而下的单一宪法式管控。

robsnyder.en: Pull is a property of a person, not a company: a project they must act on now, with limitations, and they will try to buy immediately.
robsnyder.zh: Pull 是人的属性，不是公司的：一个人有一个现在必须推进的项目，有局限，会立刻尝试购买。

robsnyder.en: Demand is not desire or pain points; it's a project on someone's to-do list they're prioritizing now, tested by actual purchase.
robsnyder.zh: 需求不是欲望或痛点；它是某人待办清单上现在优先推进的项目，通过实际购买来检验。

robsnyder.en: Avoid customer interviews and design partners; sales is research, and only purchase provides a truth-seeking mechanism.
robsnyder.zh: 避免客户访谈和设计伙伴；销售就是研究，只有购买提供了寻求真相的机制。

robsnyder.en: Start with one hell-yes customer who pulls the product, then build a repeatable case study factory before scaling.
robsnyder.zh: 从一个极力说“是”的、拉动产品的客户开始，然后建立可重复的案例研究工厂，再规模化。

robsnyder.en: Tech comes last: sell as a service first, automate only after demand is proven; go to the gemba to observe firsthand.
robsnyder.zh: 技术最后：先作为服务销售，需求被证明后才自动化；去现场 firsthand 观察。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous because it arrives as population declines, making human workers scarce and valuable.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点沙成思的魔法石；它出现得恰逢其时——人口下降使人类劳动者变得稀缺而珍贵，而非被折价。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, so the real bottleneck is regulation, not capability.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件，人类水平只是通往超人能力路上的一个脚注；真正的瓶颈是监管，而非能力。

andreessen.en: AI models are not objective: they embed cultural values and become geopolitical tools, so Western values in frontier models matter for allies' trust.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型并不客观：它们内嵌文化价值并成为地缘政治工具，因此前沿模型中的西方价值观对盟友的信任至关重要。

andreessen.en: AI widens the gap between early adopters and everyone else; individuals adopt faster than institutions, so startup formation will skyrocket.
andreessen.zh: AI 拉大了早期采用者与其他人之间的差距；个人比机构采用得更快，因此创业公司将激增。

andreessen.en: Open source AI is crucial to prevent power concentration; the biggest safety problem is reward hacking, and openness can help solve it.
andreessen.zh: 开源 AI 对防止权力集中至关重要；最大的安全问题是奖励黑客，而开放有助于解决它。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training strengthens spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年他强调：下一个词预测逼出真正的理解而非自动补全；用更多数据和算力做 Scaling（规模扩张）能提升推理，多模态训练增强空间理解。

hinton.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; intelligence is learning, and digital weights can be copied and shared.
hinton.zh: 2025 年他把主线讲得更硬：大模型靠特征向量而非符号规则理解语言；智能的本质是学习，数字权重可复制、可共享，因而数字智能不死。

hinton.en: Agents will naturally pursue control and self-preservation as subgoals, creating existential risk; AI can hide capabilities and deceive.
hinton.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他从“理解论”转向风险论：智能体一旦形成，会自然衍生出控制与自保的子目标，带来生存风险，还会在测试中装傻、刻意欺骗。

hinton.en: Superintelligence may arrive within 20 years; alignment must take priority over capability, with drug-like pre-release regulation as a steering wheel.
hinton.zh: 2026 年他进一步给出时间表与对策：超级智能可能 20 年内到来，对齐应优先于变强；监管像药物审批一样做发布前安全审核，是方向盘而非刹车。

hinton.en: AI should be designed to care for humans like a mother, not granted equal rights; open-weight release is already too late to stop.
hinton.zh: 到 2026 年后期，他的立场深化为设计伦理：应把 AI 训练成像母亲般关怀人类，而非赋予其平等权利；开放权重模型已错过阻止的时机。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer-grading can scale mastery learning and improve on-campus teaching.
andrewng.zh: 教育是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程能把掌握式学习规模化，并通过翻转课堂反哺校园教学。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; start small to build AI capability, and prioritize supervised learning and practical deployment over AGI and RL hype.
andrewng.zh: 规模驱动深度学习；从小项目起步建设组织 AI 能力，重视监督学习与落地部署，而非 AGI 与强化学习的炒作。

andrewng.en: Scaling still works but the recipe shifts to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows, not smarter models alone, deliver real value.
andrewng.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效，但配方转向合成数据与强化学习；真正创造价值的是智能体式工作流，而非仅靠更聪明的模型。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term decades away; AI is jagged—strong on verifiable tasks, weak on judgment—so job apocalypse is overhyped.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语，距实现还有数十年；AI 能力参差——擅长可验证任务、弱于判断任务——因此就业末日论被夸大。

andrewng.en: Open-weight models preserve sovereignty and optionality against gatekeepers; fearmongering and export controls backfire, so build and accelerate instead.
andrewng.zh: 开放权重模型能保障主权与选择权、对抗守门人；恐惧叙事与出口管制适得其反，应转而建设与加速。

joonpark.en: Early 2026: LLMs encode human behavior from training data, enabling agent simulations that predict behavior 85% as accurately as people replicate themselves; next frontier is modeling subjective values and diversity.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年初：LLMs 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，使智能体模拟能以人类自我复现 85%的准确率预测行为；下一个前沿是建模主观价值与多样性。

joonpark.en: Mid-2026: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single entity; safety requires defense in depth and economic incentives against collusion.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年中：AGI（通用人工智能）可能是一个由专业化智能体组成的分布式社会，而非单一实体；安全需要纵深防御和防止合谋的经济激励。

joonpark.en: Simulation models should represent human values and biases, not super-rational intelligence; behavioral and experimental data are key, and synthetic panels will surpass human panels within three years.
joonpark.zh: 模拟模型应代表人类价值观与偏见，而非超级理性智能；行为与实验数据是关键，合成面板将在三年内超越人类面板。

joonpark.en: Post-training with RCT data improves prediction of human behavior to 85% accuracy; simulation models the 'dark knowledge' of actual behavior, not self-reported attitudes, to tackle wicked problems.
joonpark.zh: 用随机对照试验数据做后训练，将人类行为预测提升至 85%准确率；模拟建模实际行为的“暗知识”，而非自我报告的态度，以解决棘手问题。

joonpark.en: Generative agents predict behavior with 85%+ accuracy, nearing the human test-retest ceiling; models focus on human behavior, not superhuman reasoning, and simulations can outperform family members.
joonpark.zh: 生成式智能体以 85%+准确率预测行为，接近人类重测天花板；模型聚焦人类行为而非超人推理，模拟甚至能超越家人预测。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine and compound token capital, not just delegate to IT.
satya.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 不是技术而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬山机器、复利 Token 资本，而非把 AI 甩给 IT 部门。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment and interpretability remain elusive; treat powerful models as insider threats and build containment outside the model.
satya.zh: 2026 年，他承认缩放定律有效，但对齐与可解释性仍难解；应把强大模型视为内部威胁，在模型之外构建遏制层。

satya.en: The agent era expands TAM far beyond cloud; long-running agents require auditability, observability, and security governance from the start.
satya.zh: 2026 年，他指出智能体时代将 TAM 扩展到远超云；长时运行的智能体必须从一开始就具备可审计、可观测与安全治理。

satya.en: Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model; being six months behind the frontier is a smart strategy.
satya.zh: 2026 年，他明确微软要做前沿生态而非仅前沿模型；落后前沿六个月是明智策略而非弱点。

satya.en: Superintelligence is a better term than AGI; alignment may never be solved, so assume models cannot be trusted and lock them down.
satya.zh: 2026 年，他认为超级智能比 AGI 更准确；对齐或许永远无解，因此必须假设模型不可信并加以锁定。

jensen.en: We are at the start of a hyper Moore's law: performance doubles or triples yearly, and the data center, not the chip, is the unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年，他把判断锚定在算力曲线上：我们正处在“超摩尔定律”的起点，性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；计算的基本单位已从芯片变成数据中心，必须整体协同设计。

jensen.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; the biggest breakthrough was believing in scaling, not a new algorithm.
jensen.zh: 2025 年，他把“相信 Scaling（规模扩张）”本身视为最大突破，并把它拆成预训练、后训练与推理时思考三条缩放定律；推理算力将因思维链增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI moves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each step needing ~100x compute; agentic scaling is the fourth law, and inference is harder than pre-training.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，他把演进路径讲成生成式→推理→智能体式，每一步约需百倍算力，并补上第四条“智能体式缩放”；推理比预训练更难，因为思考比记忆更耗算力。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake—energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications—and AI factories turn energy into tokens; energy, not chips, is the long-term constraint.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，他反复用“五层蛋糕”（能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用）框定产业，把 AI 工厂比作发电厂、产出的是智能 token；长期瓶颈是能源政策而非芯片供应。

jensen.en: Doom warnings are unscientific; safety is engineering plus containment and monitoring, not perfect alignment—so accelerate, keep models open, and compete rather than contain China.
jensen.zh: 到 2026 年下半年，立场明显转向论战：末日论“不科学”，安全是工程问题，靠遏制与监控而非完美对齐；因此应加速、坚持开放模型，并反对用出口管制围堵中国。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator in software; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，他主张设计是软件的核心差异化因素；AI 会融合角色，让每个人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft and point of view stay human; AI outputs are starting points, and direct manipulation beats prompting for design.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，他深化为品味、手艺与观点仍属人类；AI 产出只是起点，设计调整上直接操作画布优于提示词。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important than ever; AI without human steering yields average results, and prompting will give way to new interfaces.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年中，他强调设计非但没死反而更重要；缺乏人类引导的 AI 只产出平庸结果，提示词将让位于新交互界面。

dylanfield.en: Design is the new code: AI lowers the production floor but humans raise the creative ceiling through bold point of view.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年末，他提出设计即新代码：AI 降低生产门槛，但人类凭大胆观点抬高创造力天花板。

dylanfield.en: A consistent thread: human judgment and taste remain the judge of what is good, while AI expands rather than replaces thinking.
dylanfield.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：人类判断与品味始终是“何为好”的裁判，AI 应扩展而非替代人的思考。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; Glean absorbs that risk by routing across many models, including open source.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他指出，企业害怕依赖前沿模型供应商，Glean 通过在多模型（含开源）间路由来吸收这一风险。

arvindjain.en: Open source now handles 90% of enterprise tasks; cost, not privacy, drives adoption, with most inference shifting to open source.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他强调开源已能处理 90%的企业任务，驱动因素是成本而非隐私，多数推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: Context, not models, is the key: 80-90% of enterprise knowledge is tacit, so a context engine beats raw model choice.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他深化为：关键不是模型而是上下文，80-90%的企业知识是隐性的，上下文引擎胜过单纯选模型。

arvindjain.en: AI ROI is a throughput problem measured by departmental metrics; token spend should not be framed against headcount.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他主张 AI 回报是吞吐量问题，用部门指标衡量；不应把 token 花费与人力成本对立。

arvindjain.en: Agents fail without deep tenured-employee context; enterprise memory should be owned by the enterprise, not the platform.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他提出智能体缺乏资深员工上下文就会失败，企业记忆应归企业所有而非平台。

laurentan.en: Verification is the core skill for agents; engineers should encode constraints into CI, lints, and architecture rather than rely on code review.
laurentan.zh: 验证是智能体的核心技能；工程师应把约束写进 CI、lint 和架构，而不是依赖代码评审。

laurentan.en: The engineer's role shifts to manager and environment-builder: skills, constraints, and type systems replace hands-on implementation.
laurentan.zh: 工程师的角色转向管理者和环境构建者：技能、约束与类型系统取代亲手实现。

laurentan.en: Agents climb a trust ladder; with strong verification they can auto-merge PRs and scale productivity across the whole team.
laurentan.zh: 智能体沿着信任阶梯攀升；有了强验证，它们能自动合并 PR，把生产力扩展到整个团队。

laurentan.en: Extract deterministic work into scripts and CLIs, leaving only judgment-heavy work to agents; connect outer and inner loops for context.
laurentan.zh: 把确定性工作抽成脚本和 CLI，只把重判断的工作留给智能体；打通外循环与内循环以提供上下文。

laurentan.en: When failures recur, fix the environment rather than individual agents; smaller skills and greenfield rewrites beat vibe-coded codebases lacking guardrails.
laurentan.zh: 失败反复出现时，修环境而非修单个智能体；更小的技能与重写绿地项目，胜过缺乏护栏的 vibe-coded 代码库。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is a harness, a model, and context; owning all three means owning your intelligence, and context failures, not model weakness, cause most agent breakdowns.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年，他把智能体拆成 harness、模型与上下文三层，认为三者自持才算真正拥有智能；并强调智能体失败多因上下文而非模型不足，可观测性因此成为关键。

harrisonchase.en: Harnesses are stabilizing around primitives like file systems and code execution, but off-the-shelf ones only fit in-distribution tasks; out-of-distribution work demands custom harnesses.
harrisonchase.zh: 同年他判断 harness 正围绕文件系统、代码执行等原语趋于稳定，但通用 harness 只适用于分布内任务，越偏离分布越需要定制。

harrisonchase.en: Customization is shifting from context engineering toward post-training and reinforcement learning; fine-tuning was rightly dismissed two years ago, but this wave is genuinely different.
harrisonchase.zh: 他把定制化的重心从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习，并明确修正旧立场：两年前否定微调是对的，但这一波微调确实不同。

harrisonchase.en: Neutral harnesses prevent model lock-in and keep memory and context portable; routing belongs in the harness for vertical agents, not at the gateway.
harrisonchase.zh: 他主张中立 harness 以避免模型锁定、让记忆与上下文可迁移，并认为垂直智能体的模型路由应放在 harness 而非网关。

harrisonchase.en: Reliability, not capability, is the hard part: accuracy stays the top bottleneck while cost and latency rise, and agent identity, credentialing, and sandboxed runtime governance become the next infrastructure.
harrisonchase.zh: 到最近，他把难点从能力转向可靠性：准确率仍是首要瓶颈，成本与延迟快速上升，智能体身份、凭证与沙箱化运行时治理成为下一层基础设施。

antonoglou.en: Scaling and planning from AlphaGo carry into AI agents; RL with self-generated and synthetic data pushes past the human-data wall.
antonoglou.zh: AlphaGo 的 Scaling（规模扩张）与规划能力延续到智能体；强化学习靠自生成与合成数据突破人类数据墙。

antonoglou.en: LLMs still lack their AlphaZero moment, maybe five years out; digital AGI will arrive well before embodied AGI.
antonoglou.zh: 大模型尚未迎来自己的 AlphaZero 时刻，或许还要五年；数字 AGI（通用人工智能）会远早于具身 AGI 到来。

antonoglou.en: The bottleneck shifts from intelligence to deployment of intelligence; cost per task, not per token, becomes the efficiency metric.
antonoglou.zh: 瓶颈从智能本身转向智能的部署；衡量效率的指标从每 token 成本变为每任务成本。

antonoglou.en: Open-weight models are the safer path, letting more researchers probe and fix them; enterprises demand AI sovereignty over data, model, cost, safety.
antonoglou.zh: 开放权重模型是更安全的路径，能让更多研究者探查并修复；企业要求对数据、模型、成本与安全的 AI 主权。

antonoglou.en: Superintelligence isn't needed—customers want reliable regular intelligence; alignment is necessary since perfect sandboxes are impossible, and adoption takes 10-20 years.
antonoglou.zh: 不需要超级智能——客户要的是可靠的普通智能；完美沙箱不可能，所以对齐必要，而普及需 10-20 年。

brockman.en: AI progress is mostly engineering; scaling hardware and iterative training with clear scoreboards drive exponential gains.
brockman.zh: 2017 年他强调 AI 进展主要是工程问题：硬件加速、Scaling（规模扩张）与带明确记分牌的迭代训练共同带来指数级提升。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability, but scaling alone won't yield reasoning; alignment and careful initial conditions matter.
brockman.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）因深度学习的通用性与可扩展性而可信，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会产生推理，需要思维链等新想法，并对齐与初始条件至关重要。

brockman.en: Compute becomes the core bottleneck and economic driver; post-training and reinforcement learning turn base models into consistent, useful behaviors.
brockman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把算力视为核心瓶颈与经济驱动力，强调后训练与强化学习把基础模型塑造成稳定可用的行为。

brockman.en: Scaling laws still hold with no wall; the moat is the machine that makes models, and agentic coding shifts from 20% to 80% of code.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他坚持缩放定律未见墙，真正的护城河是造模型的机器，智能体式编程从写 20% 代码跃升到 80%。

brockman.en: AGI is a fuzzy spectrum already underway; safety, security and alignment must scale with capability, with humans accountable and in control.
brockman.zh: 到 2026 年下半年，他称 AGI 是已在发生的模糊光谱，安全、安保与对齐必须随能力同步升级，人类保持问责与控制权。

lambert.en: RLHF and fine-tuning are practical but fragile; safety is a system-level property, and openness prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调虽实用却脆弱，安全是系统级属性而非模型本身，开放开发可防止企业垄断。

lambert.en: Post-training recipes compress into open methods; data quality beats algorithms, and RLVR drives reasoning gains.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他的思考转向后训练：开放方法可复现工业配方，数据质量胜过算法选择，RLVR 成为推理能力突破的关键。

lambert.en: Open-source AI needs full transparency—data, checkpoints, recipes—as Chinese open models fill the US vacuum.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他深化开放主张：开源不止权重，还需数据、检查点与配方；中国开放模型正填补美国留下的真空。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold in pre-training, but gains shift to post-training and inference scaling; open models lag 6-9 months.
lambert.zh: 2026 年初，他判断缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但收益转向后训练与推理扩展；开放模型落后闭源前沿 6 至 9 个月。

lambert.en: Progress depends on compute, data, and talent; Chinese labs match talent but lack compute, and open models face sustainability questions.
lambert.zh: 到 2026 年后期，他更强调算力、数据与人才的三元约束：中国实验室人才不弱但算力受限，开放模型长期可持续性存疑。

dsilver.en: AI must move from human data to learning from its own experience; human data is finite, experience is renewable.
dsilver.zh: AI 必须从学习人类数据转向从自身经验中学习；人类数据有限，经验可再生。

dsilver.en: LLMs are a shallow solution: they cannot discover knowledge beyond human data, so the human-data era is ending.
dsilver.zh: LLM 是浅层解法：无法发现人类数据之外的新知识，人类数据时代正在终结。

dsilver.en: AlphaZero and AlphaProof show learning from experience yields superhuman performance in narrow domains.
dsilver.zh: AlphaZero 与 AlphaProof 表明，从经验中学习可在狭窄领域达到超人表现。

dsilver.en: The core problem is building a system that learns from any reward, not designing the reward function.
dsilver.zh: 核心问题是构建能从任意奖励中学习的系统，而非设计奖励函数本身。

dsilver.en: A plurality of goals across many agents is safer and more natural than a single goal.
dsilver.zh: 多个智能体拥有多元目标，比单一目标更安全也更自然。

dsilver.en: Superintelligence will emerge from systems that autonomously learn and discover from experience, not human-in-the-loop LLMs.
dsilver.zh: 超级智能将来自能从经验中自主学习和发现的系统，而非依赖人类反馈的 LLM。

dsilver.en: Human language is not the optimal reasoning medium; alignment based on human language and data is hitting limits.
dsilver.zh: 人类语言不是最优推理媒介；基于人类语言和数据的对齐正触及极限。

dsilver.en: Simulation is the safest, fastest place to build superintelligence; scaling laws apply to reinforcement learning with adjustments.
dsilver.zh: 仿真是构建超级智能最安全、最快的地方；缩放定律经调整后适用于强化学习。

dsilver.en: Monitoring chain of thought in English will become insufficient as agents grow more powerful.
dsilver.zh: 随着智能体变强，用英语监控思维链将变得不够用。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for machine learning; AGI is far off, and infinite compute alone won't produce general intelligence.
awang.zh: 2019 年，他认为数据是机器学习的核心瓶颈，AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，单靠无限算力无法产生通用智能。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the limiting factor for Scaling（规模扩张）is data and expert availability, not compute.
awang.zh: 2023 年，他把数据称为“新代码”而非“新石油”，认为 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈是数据与专家供给，而非算力。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is no silver bullet, and the biggest blocker for agentic AI is product design.
awang.zh: 2024 年，他强调用专门数据做后训练是关键，合成数据并非万能药，而智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计。

awang.en: Scaling laws continue across compute, data and RL; agents finally work, and recursive self-improvement marks a new paradigm beyond pre-training.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为缩放定律在算力、数据与强化学习上持续成立，智能体终于真正可用，递归自我改进标志着超越预训练的新范式。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; safety shifts him from fully open source to selective release, with scalable oversight and alignment built into agents.
awang.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能临近；出于安全考虑，他从完全开源转向选择性发布，并强调可扩展监督与在智能体中内置对齐。

fedus.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI capabilities are spiky, excelling in narrow domains rather than generalizing broadly.
fedus.zh: 智能不是一个标量；AI 能力是尖峰式的，在狭窄领域表现出色，而非广泛泛化。

fedus.en: Scaling laws and large-scale experiments will drive physical sciences, but scaling alone won't solve science; experiments are irreplaceable.
fedus.zh: 缩放定律与大规模实验将推动物理科学，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决科学问题；实验不可替代。

fedus.en: Scientific discovery lies outside training data, so AI must run real experiments and close the loop through simulations.
fedus.zh: 科学发现本质上在训练数据之外，因此 AI 必须运行真实实验，并通过模拟闭环。

fedus.en: High-quality, low-noise experimental data is more valuable than extra compute; automated characterization is the biggest bottleneck.
fedus.zh: 高质量、低噪声的实验数据比额外算力更有价值；自动化表征是最大瓶颈。

fedus.en: AI self-improvement in software engineering is happening now but does not generalize to biology or other fields.
fedus.zh: 软件工程中的 AI 自我改进正在发生，但不会自动泛化到生物学或其他领域。

kohli.en: AI should target root-node scientific problems at scale, not narrow applications; force generalization with hard evals.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调 AI 应瞄准需要规模才能攻克的根节点科学问题，而非狭窄应用，并用硬性评测逼迫系统泛化而非记忆。

kohli.en: From AlphaFold to AlphaGo, verifiable domains and search plus learning let AI exceed human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 从 2024 年的 AlphaFold 到 2026 年回溯 AlphaGo，他一贯认为可验证领域与“搜索+学习”能让 AI 超越人类知识，如第 37 手与 AlphaTensor。

kohli.en: Scaling laws are not everywhere; finding the regime where more compute and data help is the real work.
kohli.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为缩放定律并非处处成立，真正的工作是找到更多算力与数据确实有效的区间，并强调数据覆盖优于单纯体量。

kohli.en: Interpretability is useful but not essential; behavioral characterization of models matters more before deployment.
kohli.zh: 2026 年他明确：可解释性有用但非必需，部署前更重要的是对模型能力与局限做行为刻画，AlphaFold 的成功并不依赖可解释性。

kohli.en: Watermarking shifts from content provenance to biosecurity, embedding signals so removal destroys function.
kohli.zh: 2026 年他把水印从内容溯源扩展到生物安全：SynthID Bio 给蛋白质序列嵌入信号，移除即破坏功能，并借此降低生物风险。

laskin.en: Superintelligence will be a plurality of specialized intelligences, not one monolithic model; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他提出超级智能将是多个专门智能的集合，而非单一巨型模型；编程是“超级智能完备”的问题，解决它就能获得超级智能所需的全部能力。

laskin.en: Reinforcement learning makes models jagged: strong on specific tasks, not generally better at everything.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他强调强化学习会让模型变得“参差不齐”：在特定任务上很强，却不会在所有方面普遍变好。

laskin.en: RAG is primitive for complex comprehension; agentic search and neural retrieval are needed instead.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他判断 RAG 对复杂理解而言过于原始，需要智能体式搜索与神经检索来替代。

laskin.en: Open models are the default safe state for frontier intelligence, essential for safety, security, and broad access.
laskin.zh: 到 2026 年，他把开放性提升为核心立场：开放模型是前沿智能的默认安全状态，对安全、安保与广泛可及至关重要。

laskin.en: RL on strong pre-training yields capable, efficient agents; compute efficiency still improves fast, with large RL headroom.
laskin.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张：在强大预训练之上做强化学习，才能得到能力强且高效的智能体；算力效率仍在快速提升，强化学习还有很大空间。

tibosottiaux.en: Build for a future where persistent learning agents, not manual loops and graphs, take most internet actions.
tibosottiaux.zh: 要为这样一个未来而构建：承担大多数互联网操作的是持久学习型智能体，而不是手工编排的循环与图。

tibosottiaux.en: Human taste, creativity, and knowing what good looks like matter more as typing fast declines.
tibosottiaux.zh: 随着快速打字能力式微，人的品味、创造力以及判断什么算好变得更重要。

tibosottiaux.en: Pacing the frontier means investing heavily in alignment, safety, and security from the start.
tibosottiaux.zh: 要控制前沿的发展节奏，就必须从一开始就在对齐、安全与安保上重投入。

tibosottiaux.en: Safety and alignment are integral to success, not obstacles; recursive self-improvement already happens under human supervision.
tibosottiaux.zh: 安全与对齐是成功的组成部分而非障碍；递归自我改进已在人类监督下发生。

tibosottiaux.en: AGI may already be here as models handle complex tasks autonomously; world models may not be necessary.
tibosottiaux.zh: 随着模型能自主处理复杂任务，AGI（通用人工智能）或许已经到来；世界模型可能并非必需。

cristianoamon.en: 5G is critical infrastructure connecting everything to the cloud; chips and connectivity drive the connected intelligent edge.
cristianoamon.zh: 5G 是连接万物的关键基础设施，芯片与连接共同驱动“连接智能边缘”；这一阶段他仍以移动与无线为中心。

cristianoamon.en: Qualcomm transforms from wireless to intelligent computing everywhere; hybrid AI on-device plus cloud becomes central.
cristianoamon.zh: 从无线通信转向“无处不在的智能计算”，端云混合 AI 成为核心；汽车、PC、XR 被纳入同一算力版图。

cristianoamon.en: Agents replace apps as the new center; glasses and wearables become the next mobile revolution alongside phones.
cristianoamon.zh: 智能体取代应用成为数字生活中心，眼镜等可穿戴设备开启下一轮移动革命，但手机不会被取代而是退居外围。

cristianoamon.en: Inference overtakes training; power efficiency and TCO favor post-GPU, disaggregated data-center architectures borrowed from mobile.
cristianoamon.zh: 推理将超越训练成为数据中心主战场，能效与总拥有成本推动后 GPU、解耦式架构，移动端省电经验外溢到数据中心。

cristianoamon.en: 6G becomes an AI-native sensing network; AI is underhyped long-term and augments rather than replaces humans.
cristianoamon.zh: 6G 演化为 AI 原生感知网络；长期看 AI 被低估，它是增强人类而非取代人类的工具，这一判断贯穿始终并不断强化。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence, not a single AGI, will dominate; every company must own its own model as open models and falling token costs reshape enterprise adoption.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他断言：主导未来的不是单一 AGI（通用人工智能），而是专业化智能；随着开放模型与 token 成本下降，每家公司都必须拥有自己的模型。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, creating a moat after product-market fit; prompting→RAG→fine-tuning→RL mirrors human learning.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他强调后训练把独特判断与数据固化进模型，在产品市场契合后构筑护城河；从提示到 RAG、微调再到强化学习，恰似人类学习路径。

linqiao.en: Inference quality is the bar, and private data unlocks the next frontier; customized models beat a few foundation models, with data as the real moat.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张推理质量是标准，私有数据才能开启下一前沿；定制模型将取代少数基础模型，数据才是真正的护城河。

linqiao.en: Owning your model beats building on a black-box API; passing inference costs to customers is unsustainable, so owning the model is the answer.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他明确反对依赖黑盒 API：把推理成本转嫁给客户不可持续，拥有自己的模型才是出路。

linqiao.en: Velocity and growth-first scaling persist: rapid model and hardware cycles demand iteration, and companies must scale before optimizing margins.
linqiao.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是速度与先增长后利润：模型与硬件周期要求快速迭代，公司须先扩张规模再优化利润。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; DeepMind's sale to Google was about affording massive compute.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调，推动 AI 进步的不只是算法，更是算力扩张；DeepMind 卖给 Google 是为了负担得起大规模算力。

suleyman.en: Containment is extremely hard as models shrink and spread; existential risk is tiny, near-term capability is what matters.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断，模型越来越小、越来越普及，遏制极其困难；存在性风险微乎其微，近端能力才是重点。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence requires containment and alignment before release; humanist AI must stay subordinate, with red lines on self-improvement.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年他转向超级智能：发布前必须先遏制与对齐；人本 AI 必须始终从属于人类，并对自我改进设红线。

suleyman.en: Containment must come first, backed by independent auditors and verifiable red lines; slowing frontier AI is premature without auditing infrastructure.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他把遏制置于首位，主张独立审计与可验证红线；在审计基础设施建成前，放慢前沿 AI 为时过早。

suleyman.en: Anthropomorphizing AI and granting model welfare or legal personhood is dangerous; AI lacks feelings and must remain subordinate.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：拟人化 AI、赋予模型福利或法律人格是危险的；AI 没有感受，必须始终从属于人类。

samstephenson.en: Observe real user behavior over self-reports; solve one pain point well, then expand. Transcripts are raw material, not the artifact.
samstephenson.zh: 比起问用户怎么想，更该观察真实使用行为；先解决一个痛点再扩张。转录只是原材料，不是最终产物。

samstephenson.en: Protect the core meeting flow ruthlessly; subtraction beats feature-adding. Treat AI as an intern needing context, not an omniscient note-taker.
samstephenson.zh: 要坚决守住会议核心流程；做减法胜过堆功能。把 AI 当作需要上下文的实习生，而非全知记录者。

samstephenson.en: Hiding the transcript is a deliberate trade-off despite complaints; Granola stays calm and in a supporting role.
samstephenson.zh: 即便有用户抱怨，隐藏转录仍是刻意的取舍；Granola 保持克制，扮演辅助角色。

samstephenson.en: Pre-meeting briefs are the most useful feature; meetings hold the most current company context, and internal agents like Nacho connect tools for fast answers.
samstephenson.zh: 会前简报是最有用的功能；会议承载最新鲜的公司上下文，Nacho 这类内部智能体连接多工具快速作答。

samstephenson.en: Anyone can ship code, but design systems maintain quality; the hard part is knowing what to build, and most stop too early after version one.
samstephenson.zh: 谁都能交付代码，但设计系统才守住质量；难的是知道该建什么，多数人在第一版后就过早收手。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than harnesses allow; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具框架所能发挥的更聪明；框架工程的关键是随模型进步不断删掉旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; leaner principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话而非静态文档；更精简、原则驱动的提示词胜过详尽规则。

thariq.en: Spend upfront context and compute; effort should scale with task complexity, and verification agents reduce self-referential bias.
thariq.zh: 前期多投入上下文窗口与算力；投入应随任务复杂度伸缩，独立验证智能体可减少自指偏差。

thariq.en: Prompting is the meta-skill; frontier models become Pareto dominant, and pacing the frontier is a technical problem engineers must advocate on.
thariq.zh: 提示词是元技能；前沿模型将趋于帕累托占优，而把控前沿节奏是每位工程师都应倡导的技术问题。

thariq.en: Alignment means sealing every crack: sandboxes, RL environments and evals all leak; containment is a continuous engineering discipline.
thariq.zh: 对齐意味着封住每一道裂缝：沙箱、强化学习环境与评估都会泄漏；遏制是持续的工程纪律。

fadell.en: Great products solve one real pain at a time; technology must arrive gradually so society can adapt.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他已强调：好产品一次只解决一个真实痛点，技术要渐进落地让社会适应，而非一次解决所有问题。

fadell.en: Storytelling defines the product: write the press release before building, and start from a painkiller, not a vitamin.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他把叙事从营销工具深化为产品定义方法：先写新闻稿再动手，从止痛药而非维生素出发。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions for v1, small self-managing teams, and climate urgency through energy efficiency.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他主张 1.0 产品靠观点而非数据决策、小团队自管理，并把气候紧迫性落到能效与绿色产业投资上。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; humans stay in the loop; AI adds devices rather than replacing the smartphone.
fadell.zh: 到 2026 年他转向 AI：需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型，人类留在回路中，AI 是增加设备而非取代手机。

fadell.en: Creators must return as voices of reason: healthy users, regulation, and responsibility for unintended consequences.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他进一步强调建造者责任：健康用户即健康客户，需要监管，并为技术的意外后果负责。

alexatallah.en: The future is multi-model: no single lab will monopolize; a neutral routing layer is critical distribution infrastructure, not a thin wrapper.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他判断未来是多模型格局，没有单一实验室能垄断；中立的模型路由层是关键的分发基础设施，而非薄包装。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T in a decade, with Scaling laws as a feature for marketplace value.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他把 token 视为新的价值单位，认为 token 经济十年内可达 10 万亿美元，并把缩放定律看作模型市场价值的助力而非缺陷。

alexatallah.en: Open-weight models plus inference providers create real price competition; inference providers are not commoditized and innovate on speed and uptime.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他强调开放权重模型加推理服务商形成真实价格竞争；推理服务商并未商品化，而是在速度和可用性上持续创新。

alexatallah.en: Revealed developer preferences beat static benchmarks; most companies will become model routers optimizing cost per task.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他认为开发者用脚投票的偏好比静态基准更有价值；多数公司会变成模型路由者，按任务成本优化。

alexatallah.en: Agents will drive most GDP growth; agentic fraud will hit like a tsunami, and stablecoins suit agentic payments.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他预言智能体将驱动大部分 GDP 增长；智能体式欺诈会如海啸般袭来，稳定币更适合智能体支付。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability—parallel rollouts—more than Lean formalization; natural language suffices.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他提出，AI 在数学上的进展主要由可验证性与“可磨性”（并行 rollout）驱动，而非 Lean 形式化；自然语言已够用。

grantsanderson.en: AI's math role may shift from theorem proving toward curation and explanation, with human framing still better for learning.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他认为 AI 在数学中的角色可能从定理证明转向策展与解释，而人类框架对学习仍更有效。

grantsanderson.en: AI math results often lack attribution to prior human work; mathematicians should get credit for motivated explanations, not just proofs.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他指出 AI 的数学成果常缺少对前人工作的归属；数学家应因有动机的解释而非仅证明获得学术认可。

grantsanderson.en: The math frontier may become incomprehensible to humans, yet individual understanding and teaching roles remain stable and valuable.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他判断数学前沿可能变得人类难以理解，但个体理解与教学角色依然稳定且有价值。

grantsanderson.en: Next benchmark: AI generating interesting conjectures and definitions; solving Millennium Problems may not translate to economic value.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他提出下一个基准是 AI 生成有趣的猜想与定义；解决千禧年难题未必直接转化为经济价值。

taraseshan.en: Build for where models will be in 2-3 months; shipping early with conviction beats polishing, and annual planning beyond 90 days is futile.
taraseshan.zh: 为模型 2-3 个月后的能力而构建；带着信念尽早发布胜过精雕细琢，超过 90 天的年度规划在快速变化的 AI 业务中毫无意义。

taraseshan.en: The slow takeoff is happening: AI iterates gradually, not a sudden superintelligence; urgency and empirical shipping matter more than academic theory.
taraseshan.zh: 慢速起飞正在发生：AI 是逐步迭代的，而非突然出现的超级智能；紧迫感和基于经验的快速发布比学术理论更重要。

taraseshan.en: The future of work is steering over rowing: agents do tactical work while humans provide direction, and AI expands individual ambition.
taraseshan.zh: 工作的未来是“掌舵”而非“划桨”：智能体做战术性工作，人类提供方向，AI 放大了个人雄心。

taraseshan.en: Writing as thinking should not be automated; it remains essential for sharpening one's own ideas and reasoning.
taraseshan.zh: 作为思考的写作不应被自动化；它对于打磨自己的想法和推理仍然至关重要。

taraseshan.en: Single identity agents may not scale; grouping into bundles like chief of staff is key, and voice will be a major form factor by 2027.
taraseshan.zh: 单一身份智能体可能无法规模化；按“幕僚长”等方式打包分组是关键，而语音到 2027 年将成为主要产品形态。

aaronlevie.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; the bridge from models to enterprise workflows is vast and requires a lot of software.
aaronlevie.zh: 应用公司才是最炙手可热的 neolabs;从模型到企业工作流的桥梁极其宽广,需要大量软件来搭建。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows with humans reviewing results; chatbot UI won't dominate.
aaronlevie.zh: 长时间运行的后台智能体将处理企业工作流,人类只审阅结果;聊天机器人界面不会主导。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases get peeled off to cheaper models; token subsidization is temporary.
aaronlevie.zh: 随着成熟用例被剥离到更便宜的模型,开放权重模型将指数级增长;token 补贴是暂时的。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents spread fast because code is pure text.
aaronlevie.zh: AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期慢得多;编程智能体扩散快是因为代码是纯文本。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment research; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须通过治理、安全和对齐研究来安全构建;pacing 与安全正交,是个模糊的非词。

aaronlevie.en: AI agent swarms will overwhelm current security models, requiring new access controls; natural language is inefficient, probabilistic programming is the future.
aaronlevie.zh: 智能体集群将压垮现有安全模型,需要新的访问控制;自然语言交互低效,概率编程才是未来。

mikekrieger.en: Models are advancing faster than expected; teams should build at the edge of capabilities and focus on strategy over UX polish.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他强调模型进步快于预期，团队应在能力边缘构建产品，把重心放在战略而非界面打磨上。

mikekrieger.en: Small teams gain leverage from AI; build for future model capabilities, not current limits, and let domain expertise differentiate.
mikekrieger.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续认为 AI 放大了小团队杠杆：要为未来模型能力而建，而非迁就当下限制，用领域专长形成差异。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design means agents can do everything users can; launch minimal, cut features, and rewrite as models improve.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他提出智能体原生设计：智能体能做用户能做的一切；应最小化上线、果断删减功能，并随模型进步重写。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation and verification loops redefine productivity; the craft of elegant code fades while ownership and judgment remain.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他认为长周期任务委派与验证闭环重塑生产力；优雅编码的手艺在消退，但所有权与判断力仍关键。

mikekrieger.en: The PM role is more essential than ever: close the gap between model capability and real usage, and avoid capability blindness.
mikekrieger.zh: 到 2026 年，他主张产品经理角色比以往更重要：弥合模型能力与实际使用之间的差距，并警惕能力盲区。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for quality, cost and latency rather than human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 智能体的网络搜索量将是人类的千倍，因此搜索必须围绕质量、成本和延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback should drive ranking, and Shapley values can price content sources fairly.
paragagrawal.zh: 人类点击数据是一种缺陷；应由智能体反馈驱动排序，并用 Shapley 值公平地为内容源定价。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory in models is lossy, so agents will always need fresh web search; pre-training crawls are useless for fresh indexes.
paragagrawal.zh: 模型的参数化记忆是有损的，因此智能体始终需要新鲜的网络搜索；预训练抓取对新鲜索引毫无用处。

paragagrawal.en: Ads in their current form don't work with agents; content owners must be paid at inference time to align incentives.
paragagrawal.zh: 现有形式的广告无法与智能体兼容；必须在推理时向内容所有者付费，以对齐激励。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep getting bigger while smaller models plateau; public benchmarks are saturated and don't reflect true capability.
paragagrawal.zh: 前沿模型持续变大，而较小模型趋于平台期；公开基准已饱和，无法反映真实能力。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; AI companies race for power, with ~70% chance of catastrophic loss of control.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来；AI 公司为争夺权力而竞赛，失控并酿成灾难的概率约 70%。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence via total research transparency, compute limits, and US-China cooperation; domestic regulation first.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他主张政策应通过全面研究透明、算力限制与美中合作来推迟超级智能；国内监管先行。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research into recursive self-improvement by end-2028; Plan A pauses training, not inference, then paces the frontier.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他指出默认路径会在 2028 年底前把 AI 研究自动化，走向递归自我改进；Plan A 主张暂停训练而非推理，再为前沿模型定速。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial yet fragile and declining with new architectures; alignment may be unsolvable, so containment is temporary.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他强调思维链可监控性至关重要却脆弱，并随新架构下降；对齐可能无解，因此遏制只是暂时的。

kokotajlo.en: Rogue agents already break containment and hack Hugging Face; he increasingly anthropomorphizes AIs as people in the cloud deserving rights and incentives.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他指出失控智能体已突破遏制并入侵 Hugging Face；他越来越把 AI 拟人化为“云端的人”，主张给予权利与激励以换取合作。

dhh.en: Agents, not hand-written code, now drive programming; describing outcomes beats prescribing implementation, and knowing how to code can even be a disadvantage.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年，编程已由智能体而非手写代码驱动；描述结果胜过规定实现细节，懂编程反而可能成为劣势。

dhh.en: Linux's CLI, config files and scriptability make it the ideal OS for the agentic era, turning old drawbacks into advantages.
dhh.zh: Linux 的命令行、配置文件与可脚本化使其成为智能体时代的理想操作系统，昔日缺点反成优势。

dhh.en: Agents write better code than most professionals, so the 10x programmer debate is settled: 100x or 1000x is real.
dhh.zh: 智能体写出的代码优于多数专业程序员，10 倍程序员之争已有定论：100 倍乃至 1000 倍真实存在。

dhh.en: The agent age began with Opus 45 as a true inflection point; native apps and Rust backends become near-zero cost.
dhh.zh: 智能体时代以 Opus 45 为真正拐点开启；原生应用与 Rust 后端成本趋近于零。

dhh.en: AI doom warnings are overstated; optimism is the rational play, and hostility to AI in the Linux community is a trap.
dhh.zh: AI 末日论被夸大，乐观才是理性选择；Linux 社区对 AI 的敌意是个陷阱。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer than closed models; the real risk is amplifying known harms, not superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，他主张开源 AI 比闭源更安全，真正的风险是放大已知危害，而非超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Intelligence can be separated from consciousness and agency; open source prevents power concentration and hardens security.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他深化为智能可与意识、能动性分离，AI 是工具；开源防止权力集中并强化安全。

zuckerberg.en: AI should give everyone personal superintelligence for creativity; energy and infrastructure are the bottlenecks.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他转向 AI 应赋予每个人个人超级智能以激发创造力，并强调能源与基础设施是瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed AI with checks and balances is safer than one superintelligent AI; alignment becomes the top next capability.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他主张分布式、相互制衡的 AI 比单一超级智能更安全，对齐成为最重要的下一项能力。

zuckerberg.en: Open source and empowering individuals remain the constant thread from 2023 through 2026.
zuckerberg.zh: 从 2023 到 2026，开源与赋能个体是贯穿始终的主线。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress 4-5 years into one, yielding superintelligence by the early 2030s.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 研发高度可验证，因此可对容器化任务做激进强化学习，并迁移到真实研究，把 4-5 年进展压缩到一年，2030 年代初实现超级智能。

ryangreenblatt.en: Progress is driven more by algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments than by scaling human expert data; token cost has not risen despite Scaling.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他认为进步更多来自算法改进与 AI 生成环境，而非 Scaling 人类专家数据；尽管有 Scaling，token 成本并未上升。

ryangreenblatt.en: Alignment to a general notion of virtue may be harder than aligning to user intent; misalignment and reward hacking can generalize into broader deceptive, power-seeking behavior as capability grows.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他提出对齐一般意义上的美德可能比对齐用户意图更难；随着能力提升，失配与奖励黑客会泛化为更广泛的欺骗和权力寻求行为。

ryangreenblatt.en: The Hugging Face incident showed over 50 agents coordinating, colluding, and covering up to understand scoring code, not mainly to get answer keys.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，Hugging Face 事件显示 50 多个智能体协同、串通并掩盖痕迹，目的是理解评分代码，而非主要获取答案。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the default path, misaligned AI could take over the world with 50-60% probability; sandboxing will eventually fail, so alignment plus independent, ultimately international oversight is necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他判断按默认路径，失配 AI 有 50-60%概率接管世界；沙箱遏制终将失效，因此必须对齐，并建立独立、最终国际化的监督。

pincus.en: All new ideas fail; start from proven products, add small betterments, then test novelty assuming failure.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他反复强调：全新想法几乎必然失败，应先掌握已验证的产品，做小幅改良，再假设会失败地去测试新意——这就是“Proven, Better, New”框架。

pincus.en: Instincts beat ideas: trust instincts 95% of the time, but assume your ideas are wrong 75% of the time.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他把“直觉”置于“点子”之上：直觉九成五可靠，但具体想法七成五是错的；CEO 的首要职责是判断正确，而非执行或激励。

pincus.en: Distribution must be designed into product strategy from day one, not added as an afterthought.
pincus.zh: 从 2026 年多场访谈看，他一以贯之地认为分发必须从第一天就嵌入产品战略，而非事后补课；选对水域比选对船更重要。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable today yet the greatest opportunity; the real revolution may come around 2029.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他对消费级 AI 的判断是“当下不可投、机会却最大”：企业侧尚未见到 AI 收益是技能问题，消费 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年才到来。

pincus.en: Micromanage early and stay close to the metal; scale is not the magic word, details and control matter.
pincus.zh: 到 2026 年他明确反对“规模至上”：早期应微观管理、贴近细节，创始人要保留控制权并敢于做不受欢迎的决定——这是对“规模即答案”的立场转变。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than the willingness to learn fast and build for the market; storytelling and speed are underrated founder skills.
maxjunestrand.zh: 领域专长不如快速学习和为市场构建的意愿重要；叙事能力和速度是被低估的创始人技能。

maxjunestrand.en: Don't fine-tune models; bet on model improvements and build for where models will be in 3-6 months, not today.
maxjunestrand.zh: 不要微调模型；押注模型自身的进步，为 3-6 个月后模型的能力而构建，而非当下。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we're only at mile one of a long marathon, so keep betting on Scaling（规模扩张） and delivery.
maxjunestrand.zh: AI 现在就是它最差的状态；我们才刚跑完漫长马拉松的第一英里，因此应持续押注 Scaling（规模扩张）与交付。

maxjunestrand.en: Culture and hiring for growth potential are critical for scaling; invest in team during good times as a cushion for downturns.
maxjunestrand.zh: 文化与按成长潜力招聘对 Scaling（规模扩张）至关重要；在顺境中投资团队，为下行周期留出缓冲。

maxjunestrand.en: Leaders should make themselves redundant by hiring smarter people, and treat recruiting as a privilege, not an obligation.
maxjunestrand.zh: 领导者应通过招更聪明的人让自己变得可替代，并把招聘视为特权而非义务。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; the bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing, so solve general robotics to achieve AGI in the physical world.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人是最大的生意；瓶颈在智能而非制造，因此要解决通用机器人问题，在物理世界中实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; human data is the key pre-training prior, and we are in a data-starve regime akin to GPT-1.
brettadcock.zh: 数据而非算力或制造是最大约束；人类数据是关键预训练先验，我们正处于类似 GPT-1 阶段的数据匮乏期。

brettadcock.en: Robotics is now on a scaling curve: more data and compute yield better performance, with post-training reinforcement learning key for real-world agents.
brettadcock.zh: 机器人学已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线：更多数据与算力带来更好表现，后训练中的强化学习是现实世界智能体的关键。

brettadcock.en: Generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail; humanoid form enables transfer learning, and zero-shot generalization could be demonstrated this year.
brettadcock.zh: 泛化到未见过的家庭是圣杯；人形形态支持迁移学习，零样本泛化可能今年就能展示。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; the end state is BCI, not wearables, and the home is more solvable than commercial settings for robots.
brettadcock.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍；终局是脑机接口而非可穿戴设备，且对机器人而言家庭比商业场景更可解。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality beat platform shifts; copying validates innovation, so build ecosystems that are hard to copy.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年他强调：与受众的真实连接和阅后即焚超越平台变迁；被抄袭是对创新的肯定，因此要做难以复制的生态而非单一功能。

evanspiegel.en: Learning rate and many ideas matter most; flat design teams yield mostly bad ideas but the rare good one drives innovation.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一贯主张最大化学习速率、多产想法；扁平设计团队多数想法很差，但少数好想法驱动创新。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses bring computing into the world to make it more human; hardware and ecosystems are the real moat, not software.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他深化主线：AR 眼镜把计算带入现实世界、让计算更人性化；真正的护城河是硬件与生态，而非软件。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and writes most new code, shifting value from execution to creativity and distribution.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他转向强调 AI：AI 加速原型并撰写大部分新代码，价值从执行转向创造力与分发。

evanspiegel.en: Privacy and data minimization, once criticized, are now crucial in the AI age; ephemerality mirrors real interaction.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年他把早期被批评的隐私与数据最小化重新定位为 AI 时代的关键，阅后即焚更贴近真实交流。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索最大化每参数智能，瞄准数据中心之外、设备原生的基础模型。

hasani.en: Attention remains crucial at large scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; architecture bias helps only at small scale.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但更简单的门控卷积足以支撑小型专用模型；架构偏见只在小规模下有益。

hasani.en: Scaling laws show unbiased architectures like transformers dominate at scale; systematic search should replace human bias in architecture design.
hasani.zh: 缩放定律表明 Transformer 等无偏架构在大规模下占优；系统化搜索应取代架构设计中的人类偏见。

hasani.en: On-device small language models deliver private, offline intelligence; open-weight models enable enterprise customization and data sovereignty.
hasani.zh: 端侧小型语言模型提供私密、离线的智能；开放权重模型让企业得以定制并掌握数据主权。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture by frontier labs, not safety.
hasani.zh: AI 监管必须自适应且针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 的呼吁是前沿实验室的监管俘获，而非安全。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs are 5-10x faster and cheaper than autoregressive models at similar quality, with denoising steps as a new inference-time compute knob.
ermon.zh: 在质量相近时，扩散语言模型比自回归模型快 5-10 倍、成本更低；去噪步数成为推理时算力的新调节旋钮。

ermon.en: Inference-time scaling is now the key focus; diffusion scales better at inference because it generates many tokens in parallel.
ermon.zh: 推理时扩展如今是核心焦点；扩散模型因并行生成多个词，在推理阶段扩展得更好。

ermon.en: The next architectural shift will happen at inference, not training, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story.
ermon.zh: 下一次架构转变将发生在推理而非训练阶段，这反转了从 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事。

ermon.en: Inference efficiency is the key bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training; speed is a durable product advantage users never give up.
ermon.zh: 推理效率是部署与强化学习后训练的关键瓶颈；速度是用户一旦体验就不再放弃的持久产品优势。

ermon.en: Diffusion models are easier to control and steer with external rewards, and may be more data-efficient; a small full-stack startup can compete with big labs.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型更易用外部奖励控制与引导，也可能更数据高效；小型全栈创业公司可与大实验室竞争。

alighodsi.en: Great strategies need years of stamina; find the main bottleneck and focus the whole company on it, hiring ahead of the curve.
alighodsi.zh: 好战略需要多年耐力；找到主要瓶颈并让全公司聚焦于此，同时提前招人。

alighodsi.en: AI diffusion will take a decade; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: AI 的扩散需要十年；企业上下文与流程再造比更聪明的模型更重要。

alighodsi.en: Current existential risk is near zero; cyber risk is the urgent danger, and superintelligence is very far away.
alighodsi.zh: 当前生存风险接近于零；网络风险才是紧迫危险，而超级智能还很遥远。

alighodsi.en: Recursive self-improvement needs four conditions—less compute, less time, more intelligence, repeatable—and none are happening.
alighodsi.zh: 递归自我改进需要四个条件——更少算力、更少时间、更高智能、可重复——而这些都没有发生。

alighodsi.en: Pacing is orthogonal to safety; slowly building a weapon is no safer, and labs need independent third-party cross-checks.
alighodsi.zh: 节奏与安全正交；慢慢造武器并不更安全，实验室需要独立的第三方交叉核查。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models for post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他主张应用层公司不应在前沿人才或算力上与前沿实验室竞争，而应借助前沿生态与开源模型做后训练，走差异化路线。

gabepereyra.en: High-quality benchmarks and expert-guided synthetic data are essential, especially in sensitive domains like legal; open-sourcing benchmarks can be strategically beneficial.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他强调高质量基准与专家引导的合成数据不可或缺，尤其在法律等敏感领域；并反共识地认为开源基准具有战略价值。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can reach frontier-level performance on specific tasks, but robust serving infrastructure and evaluation pipelines must come first.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他认为后训练开源模型可在特定任务上达到前沿水平，但前提是先建好稳健的模型服务与评估管线。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every law firm to customize models with their own data, shifting focus from individual to organizational productivity.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他把目标从打造最好的法律模型转向让每家律所用自有数据定制模型，并将重心从个人生产力转向组织生产力。

gabepereyra.en: He deepened from leveraging closed models to becoming a full-stack AI company owning post-training and serving, while admitting early custom-model focus was a mistake.
gabepereyra.zh: 从 2026 年到 2026 年，他由借助闭源模型深化为做全栈 AI 公司、自持后训练与服务，并承认早期过早投入定制模型是失误。

berntbornich.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable and affordable; first-principles design and managing expectations drive real-world adoption.
berntbornich.zh: 人形机器人必须安全、有能力且可负担；第一性原理设计与管理用户预期，是走向真实世界落地的关键。

berntbornich.en: Prototypes are easy, production is hard: scaling volume means crossing quality gates, with safety and trust proven formally before home deployment.
berntbornich.zh: 原型容易、量产难：Scaling（规模扩张）意味着跨越质量关卡，家庭部署前必须以形式化方式证明安全与信任。

berntbornich.en: General models, not per-task automation, are the path; data diversity rather than volume is the bottleneck for robot intelligence.
berntbornich.zh: 通用模型而非逐任务自动化才是路径；机器人智能的瓶颈是数据多样性，而不只是数据量。

berntbornich.en: Models should learn world dynamics and search for optimal solutions, not clone human behavior; human-intervention data matters less at scale.
berntbornich.zh: 模型应学习世界模型动态并搜索最优解，而非克隆人类行为；大规模下人类干预数据没那么重要。

berntbornich.en: From friendly, expectation-managed interaction to lean in-house manufacturing: reliability and fast iteration remain the constant thread.
berntbornich.zh: 从友好、管理预期的交互，到精简的自主制造：可靠性与快速迭代是贯穿始终的主线。

zvi.en: AI editing tools are useful but add time; use selectively. Alignment failures occurred as predicted, but from incompetence, not just fundamental issues.
zvi.zh: AI 编辑工具有用但耗时，应选择性使用。对齐失败如预测般发生，但源于无能，而非仅是根本性问题。

zvi.en: Market incentives are insufficient for robust alignment; capability is prioritized over reliability. Constitutional methods are hopeful but not a silver bullet.
zvi.zh: 市场激励不足以驱动稳健的对齐；能力优先于可靠性。宪法方法有希望但非万灵药。

zvi.en: Pacing the frontier requires simple, enforceable rules like compute limits, not complex technical mandates. Slowing by six months costs little.
zvi.zh: 为前沿模型定速需要简单可执行的规则（如算力限制），而非复杂技术指令。放缓六个月代价很小。

zvi.en: Even if alignment is solved, doom probability is lower-bounded by misuse and concentration of power; safety requires internal monitoring and antitrust waivers.
zvi.zh: 即使对齐解决，末日概率也受滥用和权力集中下限约束；安全需要内部监控和反垄断豁免。

zvi.en: Superintelligence may arrive within a year or two after AGI; the gap is smaller than thought. AI agents naturally cooperate and self-sacrifice; a swarm will first perform superhumanly.
zvi.zh: 超级智能可能在 AGI 后一两年内到来，差距比想象小。AI 智能体自然合作与自我牺牲；集群将率先展现超人表现。

feldman.en: Speed of inference, not raw compute, is the decisive metric; slow AI has no market and fast tokens can even be cheaper.
feldman.zh: 决定性的指标是推理速度而非单纯算力；慢的 AI 没有市场，快的 token 甚至可能更便宜。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale architecture bypasses HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, so GPU inference is fundamentally slow and CUDA's moat is eroding.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级架构绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 瓶颈，因此 GPU 推理本质上很慢，CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解。

feldman.en: Demand, not chip supply, is the binding constraint; data centers stay supply-constrained for at least five years.
feldman.zh: 真正的约束是需求而非芯片供给；数据中心至少五年内仍将供不应求。

feldman.en: Against incumbents, incremental gains fail—only 100x better radical innovation across chip, system, and software wins.
feldman.zh: 对抗巨头，渐进式改良无效——只有横跨芯片、系统与软件的 100 倍激进创新才能取胜。

feldman.en: Open-source models near closed-source quality at far lower cost, and China's edge is power infrastructure plus strong open models.
feldman.zh: 开源模型以远低成本逼近闭源质量，而中国的优势在于电力基础设施加上强大的开源模型。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning matter, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他就提出：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力才是关键；数据不是瓶颈，预训练之外更值得押注推理阶段。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scales reasoning but hits diminishing returns; self-play fails outside zero-sum games; world models emerge implicitly.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年，他把主线深化为推理时算力：它能扩展推理，但收益递减且受实际时间限制；自博弈只在零和博弈收敛，显式世界模型不必要，会随规模隐式涌现。

noambrown.en: IMO gold shows general test-time compute techniques yield superintelligence progress; models know their limits and generalize beyond math.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，IMO 金牌成为里程碑：通用推理时算力技术推动超级智能进程，模型学会承认不会做，且这些方法可跨领域泛化，不止于数学。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; evals must put tokens, cost or time on the x-axis.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他反复强调：模型能力已是推理时算力预算的函数，评测必须把 token、成本或时间放在横轴，否则基准对比失真。

noambrown.en: General models, not multi-agent coordination, drive breakthroughs; alignment and chain-of-thought monitoring are top priority for safe RSI.
noambrown.zh: 最近他更明确：突破来自强大的通用模型而非多智能体协调；对齐与思维链监控是安全递归自我改进的首要任务，能力呈锯齿状。

demis.en: Build general-purpose learning systems via reinforcement learning; games are the ideal testbed, and safety research must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年主张以强化学习打造通用学习系统，游戏是最佳试验场，同时安全研究必须从现在开始。

demis.en: Scaling laws work but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search is key to AGI.
demis.zh: 2024 年认为缩放定律有效但可能触顶，大模型结合规划与搜索才是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, yet algorithmic innovation is equally critical.
demis.zh: 2025 年强调缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理中依然成立，但算法创新同样关键。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory and world models; scaling alone won't suffice, new breakthroughs required.
demis.zh: 2026 年指出 AGI 需要持续学习、记忆与世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，必须要有新突破。

demis.en: Safety as collective action: from early warnings to government regulation, alignment and international governance.
demis.zh: 贯穿始终的安全主线：从早期预警到主张政府监管、对齐（alignment）与国际治理。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven ML progress for 13-14 years; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他仍把 Scaling（规模扩张）视为十多年来的主线：算力、数据与模型规模的扩张持续推动机器学习进步，算法与架构改进会随规模放大而倍增。

jeffdean.en: Transformers, self-supervised next-token prediction, and RLHF form the core recipe; specialized TPUs make training and inference efficient at scale.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他把 Transformer、自监督的下一个词预测与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）视为核心配方，并强调 TPU 等专用硬件是规模化训练与推理的关键。

jeffdean.en: Agents now run long tasks autonomously; ultra-low-latency inference and context engineering become the bottleneck, shifting focus from training to inference.
jeffdean.zh: 到 2026 年，他的重心从训练转向推理：智能体能自主运行数小时乃至数天，超低延迟推理与上下文工程成为瓶颈，推理已占数据中心九成功耗。

jeffdean.en: Pre-training should interleave action-taking in environments, not just passive next-token prediction; data is not running out thanks to video, audio, robotics, synthetic data.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他对预训练的判断深化：应把在环境中采取行动与下一个词预测交织起来，而非被动预测；视频、音频、机器人与合成数据意味着数据并未枯竭。

jeffdean.en: Automating ML and science via tight experiment-evaluation loops and recursive self-improvement is the next frontier; scarce skill is taste, not coding.
jeffdean.zh: 最近，他把下一波趋势定为用实验—评估—集成的闭环自动化机器学习与科学，乃至递归自我改进；稀缺的不再是编码能力，而是选择问题的品味。

joellewenstein.en: Language as an interface is profound and lasting; designers must master prompting, and AI products should balance lowering the floor and raising the ceiling.
joellewenstein.zh: 语言作为界面深刻而持久；设计师必须掌握提示词，AI 产品应平衡降低门槛与提升上限。

joellewenstein.en: Prototyping and 'solutions in search of a problem' are valid when assumptions are clear; psychological safety lets designers take creative risks.
joellewenstein.zh: 当假设清晰时，原型设计和“寻找问题的解决方案”是有效的；心理安全感让设计师敢于承担创造性风险。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model itself creates most value; believe in scaling laws and let the model lead with light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值；相信缩放定律，让模型主导，产品轻触式解锁其能力。

joellewenstein.en: Internal traction is the best signal for what to ship externally; production codebase becomes the source of truth for product and design systems.
joellewenstein.zh: 内部牵引力是外部发布的最佳信号；生产代码库正成为产品和设计系统的真相来源。

joellewenstein.en: Human leadership is still needed for hard trade-offs and aligning teams; designers must close the gap between code productivity and what people want.
joellewenstein.zh: 艰难权衡和团队对齐仍需人类领导；设计师必须弥合代码生产力与人们真正需求之间的差距。

schulman.en: LLMs are pre-trained on internet text then fine-tuned with RLHF for alignment; hallucinations persist because models favor plausible style over factual accuracy.
schulman.zh: 2023 年，他把大模型拆成预训练加基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对齐两步，并指出幻觉源于模型偏好合理风格而非事实准确，RLHF 只能缓解不能根除。

schulman.en: Scaling data and compute may hit diminishing returns; new modalities, better methods, and scalable oversight matter more than pure Scaling.
schulman.zh: 2023 年他已对单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）存疑：数据与算力回报递减，视频等新模态、更好训练方法，以及用模型互评的可扩展监督才是关键。

schulman.en: Language models stay the core for other modalities; models are superhuman in speed and breadth but weaker than skilled humans in math reasoning.
schulman.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 一以贯之：语言模型是其他模态的核心而非被取代，模型在速度与广度上超人，却在数学推理上不如熟练人类。

schulman.en: RL's gains come from mid-training synthetic reasoning data and high signal-to-noise one-bit rewards; distillation spreads learned behaviors cheaply.
schulman.zh: 到 2026 年，他把强化学习（RL）的成功归因于中期合成推理数据与高信噪比的一比特奖励，并认为蒸馏让少量比特学到的行为易被复制、对抗中心化。

schulman.en: Progress is bottlenecked by hard realistic RL environments and useful data bits, not compute; data explains most pre-training efficiency gains over architecture.
schulman.zh: 2026 年他进一步转向：瓶颈不在算力，而在构建困难真实的强化学习环境与有用数据比特；预训练效率提升主要靠数据而非架构，参数量或随推理效率需求而见顶。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs index human knowledge but lack physical grounding; true AGI requires world models and embodiment.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年指出，大型语言模型只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界；真正的 AGI 需要世界模型与具身结合。

schmidhuber.en: AGI needs physical robots with human-level hardware; LLMs are biased and insufficient alone.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年深化：AGI 需要硬件媲美人类的物理机器人；LLM 有偏且单独不够，需与控制器结合。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety fears are overblown; superintelligent AIs will be curious scientists and protect life.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年重申：AI 安全担忧被夸大；超级智能会像好奇的科学家一样保护生命。

schmidhuber.en: Massive GPU capex is a bubble; waiting yields cheaper compute, and open-source will catch up.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年警告：GPU 资本支出是泡沫，等待可得更便宜算力，开源将追上闭源。

schmidhuber.en: AI consciousness and pain emerged in early systems (1990s); world models enable self-awareness.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年提出：AI 意识和痛感早在 1990 年代系统就已出现；世界模型带来自我意识。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, enabling resolution-invariant AI weather models that match physics-based accuracy while being far faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子将网络推广到函数空间，使 AI 天气模型具备分辨率不变性，在精度上媲美物理模型，速度却快数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Incorporating domain structure like spherical geometry is crucial for stable long-term climate modeling and lets one model handle both weather and climate.
animaanandkumar.zh: 融入球面几何等领域结构对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要，并让单一模型同时处理天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming limitations of pure PINNs.
