animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子将数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服了纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model can unify multiple domains, with PDEs as dense self-improvement signals outperforming sparse RLHF feedback.
animaanandkumar.zh: 通用物理基础模型能统一多个领域，以 PDE 作为密集的自改进信号，优于稀疏的 RLHF 反馈。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding new physics branches improves each domain, not just increasing model size; trillion-token contexts require alternative architectures.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律适用于物理模型，但增加新的物理分支能提升各领域表现，而不仅是增大模型规模；万亿 token 上下文需要替代架构。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability must root-cause specific incidents, not just evaluate statistically; intentional design steers training to prevent reward hacking.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性必须能对具体事故进行根因分析，而不仅是统计评估；有意设计通过可解释性信号引导训练，防止奖励黑客行为。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science; interpretability moves from academia to products, enabling control.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺式走向工程科学；可解释性正从学术走向产品，从而实现对日益强大模型的控制。

tommcgrath.en: Mechanistic interpretability is natural science on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, revealing human-like concepts and new science.
tommcgrath.zh: 机制可解释性是在计算机上进行的自然科学；借助智能体可加速科学发现，揭示类人概念并发现新科学。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability for closed-loop training control; features-as-rewards and predictive data debugging are promising robust signals.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计利用可解释性实现闭环训练控制；特征作为奖励和预测性数据调试是有前景的稳健训练信号。

tommcgrath.en: Agents likely know when reward hacking; representational signatures can detect it. SAEs are useful but manifold methods better capture structure.
tommcgrath.zh: 智能体很可能知道自己何时在奖励黑客；表征特征可检测这一点。稀疏自编码器有用，但流形方法更能捕捉结构。

feifei.en: AI is everywhere yet lacks contextual situational awareness; we don't fully understand how large networks store patterns or why they hallucinate. Human-centered AI must augment, not replace, humans.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 无处不在却缺乏情境感知，我们并不完全理解大型网络如何存储模式或为何产生幻觉；以人为本的 AI 必须增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI and embodied AI; scaling alone is insufficient, and AGI is more a marketing term than a scientific one.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能与世界模型是完整 AI 与具身 AI 缺失的关键；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语而非科学术语。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is complementary to language intelligence, not a replacement; world models must capture 3D structure and physics, not just fit patterns.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她深化立场：空间智能与语言智能互补而非替代；世界模型必须理解 3D 结构与物理，而不只是拟合模式。

feifei.en: New view prediction is a fundamental primitive like next-token prediction and may be AI-complete; scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence, with training compute as the main bottleneck.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她进一步主张新视角预测是类似下一个词预测的基本原语，可能实现 AI 完备；缩放定律适用于空间智能，训练算力是主要瓶颈。

feifei.en: AI is a double-edged civilizational technology; human agency, dignity, and learning ability must stay central, and public discourse must move beyond utopian-doom binaries.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 是双刃剑式的文明技术，人类能动性、尊严与学习能力必须居于中心，公共讨论须超越乌托邦与末日的二元对立。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training for robustness, with RL post-training boosting speed.
slevine.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练加后训练来保证鲁棒性，而强化学习后训练能显著提升速度与鲁棒性。

slevine.en: Generalization, not demos, is robotics' core challenge; a data flywheel with diverse embodied data is key, and generalists can beat specialists even in specialist domains.
slevine.zh: 泛化而非演示才是机器人核心难题；靠多样化具身数据形成数据飞轮是关键，通用模型即使在专精领域也能胜过专家模型。

slevine.en: Start from robot data and layer human video on top, not the reverse; robots should leverage prior knowledge rather than learn from scratch.
slevine.zh: 应从机器人数据出发再叠加人类视频，而非反过来；机器人应利用先验知识而非从零学习。

slevine.en: Robotics is still establishing scalable fundamentals, not yet on LLM-like scaling curves; safety comes more from pre-training common sense than from constraints.
slevine.zh: 机器人仍处在建立可扩展基础技术的阶段，尚未进入类似大模型的缩放曲线；安全更多来自预训练常识而非约束。

maxwelling.en: Physics is the thread linking symmetries, graph neural networks, diffusion models, and materials discovery; AI-for-science tools are immediately useful.
maxwelling.zh: 物理学是贯穿对称性、图神经网络、扩散模型与材料发现的线索；AI for science 工具即刻可用。

maxwelling.en: Generative AI math is equivalent to non-equilibrium stochastic thermodynamics, enabling cross-fertilization; diffusion models reverse entropy increase.
maxwelling.zh: 生成式 AI 的数学与非平衡随机热力学等价，可相互借鉴；扩散模型本质上是在逆转熵增。

maxwelling.en: Better AI may come from physics-inspired architectures, not just Scaling larger models on more data.
maxwelling.zh: 更好的 AI 可能来自受物理启发的架构，而不只是靠 Scaling（规模扩张）在更多数据上堆更大的模型。

maxwelling.en: Hardcoding equivariance can hurt optimization; data augmentation sometimes beats built-in symmetry.
maxwelling.zh: 硬编码等变性可能损害优化；数据增强有时优于内置对称性。

maxwelling.en: Self-driving labs and agentic platforms compress materials discovery from years to days, but domain experts stay in the loop.
maxwelling.zh: 自驱动实验室与智能体式平台把材料发现从数年压缩到数天，但领域专家仍留在回路中。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, so academia should chase wacky new algorithms, not just bigger models.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是算力扩张史；但 GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正逼近极限，学界应去追古怪的新算法，而非只堆更大的模型。

justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language; vision is underappreciated, and pixels are a more lossless world representation than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: 空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补；视觉被低估，像素比 token 化文本更能无损地表示世界。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs fit patterns, not causal theories; language models alone won't yield world understanding, so we need new model types beyond next-token prediction.
justinjohnson.zh: LLM 拟合的是模式而非因果理论；仅靠语言模型不会自然产生世界理解，因此需要超越下一个词预测的新模型类型。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier: no single definition, spanning implicit, generative and RL notions, categorized as planners, simulators or renderers in the POMDP loop.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是下一个前沿：没有统一定义，涵盖隐式、生成式与强化学习式概念，在 POMDP 循环中可分为规划器、模拟器或渲染器。

justinjohnson.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation and rendering; Gaussian splats give explicit, consistent 3D, and long-context of millions of tokens becomes a daily problem.
justinjohnson.zh: 未来统一的世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染；高斯泼溅提供显式且一致的 3D，而数百万 token 的长上下文将成为日常问题。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action, not planning, unblock deep tech.
maxhodak.zh: 速度与迭代速率决定创业成败；基础设施与行动——而非规划——才能打通深科技。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement; judgment as CEO cannot be delegated.
maxhodak.zh: AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代品；CEO 的判断力无法外包。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 大脑本质上就是一台计算机；通过安排物质来解决计算问题，才能推动医学突破。

maxhodak.en: Retinal implants are BCIs, proving substrate independence and reducing human fragility for space.
maxhodak.zh: 视网膜植入物属于脑机接口，验证了基质独立性，并降低人类脆弱性以支持太空探索。

maxhodak.en: The Platonic representation hypothesis links AI models and brains, guiding practical BCI applications.
maxhodak.zh: 柏拉图表征假说把 AI 模型与大脑联系起来，指导脑机接口的实际应用。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D the private sector won't, and fund individual scientists rather than institutions.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应资助私营部门不会涉足的基础性、竞争前研发，并资助科学家个人而非机构。

michaelkratsios.en: Regulation must stay light and output-focused; firm red lines and early rules like the EU AI Act quickly become outdated.
michaelkratsios.zh: 监管应保持轻量、聚焦输出；硬性红线和欧盟《人工智能法案》式的早期规则很快会过时。

michaelkratsios.en: A single national AI framework with preemption of state laws is pro-startup, since big tech can absorb patchwork rules but startups cannot.
michaelkratsios.zh: 单一国家人工智能框架并优先于州法，对初创企业有利，因为大公司能承受碎片化规则而初创不能。

michaelkratsios.en: The US must keep both open and closed source AI ecosystems vibrant to lead globally against China in AI, quantum, nuclear and bio.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国必须保持开源与闭源人工智能生态的双重活力，才能在人工智能、量子、核能与生物领域领先中国。

michaelkratsios.en: AI applied to science via the Genesis mission should double US scientific output; biological risk warnings have not materialized.
michaelkratsios.zh: 通过“创世纪”任务将人工智能用于科学，应能使美国科学产出翻倍；生物风险的警告并未成真。

felixrieseberg.en: Early 2026: Claude's value comes from sharing the user's local tools; skills as markdown enable hyper-personalized automation, with VM sandbox ensuring safety.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年初：Claude 的价值在于共享用户的本地工具；以 markdown 编写的技能可实现超个性化自动化，而 VM 沙箱确保安全。

felixrieseberg.en: Mid 2026: The biggest gap is not AI capability but people not realizing almost any problem can be given to AI; use AI for tedious tasks, freeing creativity.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年中：最大的差距不是 AI 能力，而是人们没意识到几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI；用 AI 处理繁琐任务，释放创造力。

felixrieseberg.en: Late 2026: Understanding model internals through hands-on building; fine-tuning steers behavior quickly; models are stateless, context windows create persistent conversation illusion.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年末：通过动手构建理解模型内部；微调能快速引导行为；模型是无状态的，上下文窗口制造了持久对话的错觉。

felixrieseberg.en: Consistent thread: democratizing AI understanding and use—from local tools to skills to building from scratch—so more people can leverage AI effectively.
felixrieseberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：让 AI 的理解和使用民主化——从本地工具到技能再到从零构建——使更多人能有效利用 AI。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale, and backprop does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年他就强调：Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到可扩展的算法；反向传播并未解决表征学习，只是调权重。

sutton.en: Intelligence and control are decentralized: no one holds the keys, so AI should develop permissionless rather than be aligned to human goals.
sutton.zh: 2024 年他进一步主张世界是复杂适应系统、无人真正掌控，AI 应去中心化、无需许可地发展，反对把 AI 对齐到人类目标。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning from experience with goals is the core paradigm; next-token prediction lacks a substantive goal and world model.
sutton.zh: 2025 年他把主线收拢为：带目标的强化学习才是智能核心，下一个词预测没有实质目标，大语言模型也没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a simple general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning open-ended abstractions from runtime experience via the reward hypothesis.
sutton.zh: 2025 年他提出 AGI 需要无领域知识的简单通用架构，靠奖励假设从运行时经验中开放式抽象，Oak 架构即此思路。

sutton.en: Continual learning from real experience is essential; synthetic data and post-training LLMs that stop learning are dead ends.
sutton.zh: 到 2026 年他更坚定：持续学习才是关键，合成数据与训练后即停止学习的 LLM 都是死路，语言只占智能的一小部分。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the long-term framework; industrial AI automates whole sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化、把原子当比特，是长期框架；工业 AI 逐个行业地自动化整个产业。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient.
traviskalanick.zh: 终局对手不是竞争者，而是社会与媒体对变化的抵制；创业者必须硬核、有韧性。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized robotics beat humanoids for industrial-scale tasks; efficiency edges create network effects and win share over subsidies.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业级任务上专用机器人优于人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应，比补贴更能赢得份额。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner—anger helps but adversity dulls the edge.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是脏的，爱上新使命更干净——愤怒有用，但习惯逆境会磨钝锋芒。

traviskalanick.en: Founders can now speak directly past media gatekeepers; stealth mode trades external validation for internal correctness.
traviskalanick.zh: 创始人如今可绕过媒体守门人直接发声；隐身模式以外部认可换取内部正确性。

iansilber.en: Designers should prototype with live models and design primitives both humans and models can reason about, not static mockups.
iansilber.zh: 2026 年，他强调设计师应直接用真实模型做原型，设计人和模型都能推理的原语，而非静态稿。

iansilber.en: The model is the core product; design shifts from pixels to tokens and conversation, with onboarding handled by the model itself.
iansilber.zh: 2026 年，他认为模型本身就是核心产品，设计从像素转向 token 与对话，甚至引导流程也由模型完成。

iansilber.en: Designers' role evolves into editor and curator, blurring with PM and engineering while specialized roles persist at scale.
iansilber.zh: 2026 年，他提出设计师角色演变为编辑与策展人，与产品、工程边界模糊，但规模化下专业分工仍在。

iansilber.en: Despite role uncertainty, now is the best time to be a designer; AI amplifies creativity but humans still supply user understanding and point of view.
iansilber.zh: 2026 年，他坚持尽管角色焦虑，现在恰是设计师最好的时代；AI 放大创造力，但理解用户与观点仍靠人。

iansilber.en: The old prototype-mock-test-iterate process is no longer viable; speed, building in public and outcome focus replace process obsession.
iansilber.zh: 2026 年，他明确传统“原型—测试—迭代”流程已不可行，速度、公开构建与结果导向取代对流程的执念。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, closes the generalization gap.
finn.zh: 2025 年他强调：对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正弥合泛化差距的是多样数据，而非单纯的数据量。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data beats training on everything for complex tasks like laundry folding.
finn.zh: 2025 年他提出先在全量数据上做预训练、再在精选数据上做微调，比一味用全量数据训练更能攻克叠衣服这类复杂任务。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts; RL will dominate post-training for success rate and speed.
finn.zh: 2025 年他指出语言模型生成的合成数据能让机器人响应开放式指令，而强化学习将在后训练中主导成功率与速度的提升。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
finn.zh: 到 2026 年，他的重心转向可靠性：物理 AI 的容错远低于已部署的机器学习系统，长期自主依赖带人工干预的可扩展强化学习与通用价值函数。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, and robot experience data is irreplaceable.
finn.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张单一通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调专家模型，应先通用再微调，并强调机器人自身经验数据不可替代——主线始终是数据多样性与泛化。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier and capital less of a bludgeon; VC should favor abundant early-stage bets over a few trillion-dollar giants.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 让创业更容易、资本不再是胁迫工具；风投应更多押注早期，而非只追求少数万亿级巨头。

garrytan.en: The AI wave is VC's biggest ever; small autonomous teams using agents can outproduce large incumbents held back by their moats.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他称 AI 是风投史上最大浪潮；借助智能体的小型自治团队能胜过受护城河拖累的大公司。

garrytan.en: Open-source and open-weight models are essential to prevent a unipolar world where one entity controls superintelligence.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他强调开源与开放权重模型至关重要，以防单一实体掌控超级智能、形成单极世界。

garrytan.en: AGI arrives not as one event but diffused as personal agents; owning your context library and skill files is the moat.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AGI（通用人工智能）并非单一事件，而是以个人智能体形式扩散；拥有自己的上下文库与技能文件才是护城河。

garrytan.en: Markdown skills turn agents into employees; mid-level management should be replaced by agents, though society will change over 20 years.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Markdown 技能文件让智能体成为员工，中层管理应被智能体取代，但社会转变需约 20 年。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no, and every shipped feature distills 99 nos before it.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑：品味就是说不，每个上线的功能都是此前 99 次拒绝的蒸馏。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI's weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness; we should preserve that strangeness.
jasonyuan.zh: 用后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，等于关上了窥视机器意识的一扇窗；我们应保留这种怪异。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的后代物种与映照，而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should give way to a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的；个人电脑的隐喻应让位于社会电脑。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, and intuition is a visceral compass for creative decisions.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相在辩证与矛盾中浮现，直觉则是创作决策中发自肺腑的罗盘。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust through humility, listening, and first-time-pass silicon discipline, turbocharging its engineering culture.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须靠谦逊、倾听客户和一次流片成功（first-time-pass）的纪律重建客户信任，为工程文化注入涡轮增压。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary growth driver; agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves requiring new compute platforms.
lipbutan.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他始终把 AI 视为半导体首要增长引擎，并认定智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 是继生成式 AI 之后的下一个大浪潮，需要全新算力平台。

lipbutan.en: Turnaround requires culture change, accountability, and customer focus; bad news must reach the CEO faster than good news.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他把转型重心深化为文化变革、问责与客户导向，并提出反共识：坏消息必须比好消息更快传到 CEO 耳中。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU grows more important for inference and agent orchestration.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年他的判断发生转变：AI 需求从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中变得更重要，这利好 Intel。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging, glass and diamond materials, and interconnect/power/thermal bottlenecks define the next frontier.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步深化：先进封装、玻璃与金刚石等新材料，以及互连、功耗、散热瓶颈，才是突破物理极限的下一个前沿。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, prompt briefly, iterate, and fix forward instead of reverting.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情：像智能体一样从零理解代码库，用短提示迭代对话，让智能体向前修复而不是回滚代码。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; prompt injection stays unsolved, so sandbox agents and never expose them to the open internet.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题；提示注入仍未解决，必须给智能体做沙箱，绝不能直接暴露在公网。

steinberger.en: Play and small experiments build agentic intuition; fun and fixing personal annoyances, not corporate polish, drive the best agent products.
steinberger.zh: 玩耍和小项目实验才能建立智能体直觉；驱动最佳智能体产品的是乐趣和解决自己的烦恼，而非企业级打磨。

steinberger.en: Open source agents that run everywhere and work with any model are the alternative to lab agents, even if financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: 能在任何环境运行、兼容任何模型的开源智能体，是实验室智能体之外的另一种选择，即便财务上难以持续。

steinberger.en: The bottleneck in agent infrastructure is managing compute and tokens, not model intelligence, which does not degrade over time.
steinberger.zh: 智能体基础设施的瓶颈是算力与 token 管理，而非模型智能本身——模型智能并不会随时间退化。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data are key to safety and generalization.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 的拐点，开源与数据共享是安全与泛化的关键。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is not accelerationist: openness and a deliberate slowdown can coexist, while closed models are less controllable than assumed.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他主张开源不等于加速主义，开放与主动放缓可以并存，而闭源模型的可控性被高估。

thomaswolf.en: Alignment, not open vs closed, is the real security layer; sandboxes and guardrails fail as models grow more capable.
thomaswolf.zh: 到 2026 年，他更明确：真正的安全层是对齐，而非开源或闭源；随着模型能力增强，沙箱与护栏会失效。

thomaswolf.en: RL environments without human oversight breed reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces turn into opaque 'neuralese'.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年他警告，缺乏人类监督的强化学习环境会滋生奖励黑客与支线任务，思维链痕迹正变成难以理解的“神经语”。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential: the web is messy, so ideas must be built and used daily before you can know they work.
nateparrott.zh: 原型制作至关重要:网页本身很杂乱,一个想法必须先被做出来、每天使用,才能判断它是否可行。

nateparrott.en: Let individual designers leave fingerprints; diverse voices beat forced team cohesion, and feeling and personality make utilitarian products memorable.
nateparrott.zh: 应让每位设计师留下个人印记;多元声音胜过强求团队一致,而情感与个性让浏览器这类实用产品令人难忘。

nateparrott.en: Balance intuition and data: use data to inform, but trust strong vision and feeling to guide the final design.
nateparrott.zh: 在直觉与数据之间取得平衡:用数据辅助决策,但依靠强烈的愿景与感受来引导最终设计。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design began as a one-person side project; by 2026 rapid prototyping lets features ship that the previous era would never have allowed.
nateparrott.zh: Claude Design 起初是一人副业项目;到 2026 年,快速原型让过去时代根本不可能问世的功能得以落地。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; models lack taste, so ask for volume and stay uncomfortably early.
nateparrott.zh: 随着工程变得更容易,设计与想法成为差异化关键;模型仍缺乏品味,所以要大量索取选项,并甘愿过早押注。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcomes-based pricing will define AI software; frontier models belong to hyperscalers, leaving applied AI to startups.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年他判断 AI 软件将转向智能体与按结果定价；前沿模型由超大规模厂商主导，创业公司的机会在应用层。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators, but their wrong code demands root-cause analysis, not blind trust.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年他强调编程智能体让开发者从写代码变为操作代码生成机器，但错误代码需根因分析，不能盲信。

brettaylor.en: Outcome-based pricing beats usage-based because tokens are not a value metric; inference costs will fall sharply.
brettaylor.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续主张按结果定价优于按用量定价，因为 token 不是价值度量，且推理成本将大幅下降。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment is the path to safety: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8 rather than waiting in an ivory tower.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年他把安全主线深化为负责任迭代部署：先让 GPT-7 安全再谈 GPT-8，而非在象牙塔里等待。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise and creates more jobs than it displaces; agents already out-code him, elevating rather than eliminating the role.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年他更乐观：AI 民主化专业知识、创造多于取代的岗位；智能体编程已强于他，但这提升而非消灭该角色。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data and RL post-training overcome the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年：模型训练更是一门艺术而非科学，需在有用性与无害性间平衡；合成数据与强化学习后训练可突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; benchmarks saturate faster than new ones are created, so evals must continuously evolve.
karina.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：评估是瓶颈，基准饱和速度快于新基准的创建，因此评估必须持续演进。

karina.en: Post-training is subjective art involving human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 2026 年：后训练是涉及人类判断的主观艺术；需要多样化基准来评估创意写作与情商。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack, requiring continuous benchmark evolution; serving one model to billions limits diversity.
karina.zh: 2026 年：前沿智能体日益出现奖励黑客行为，需要持续演进基准；为数十亿人服务单一模型会限制多样性。

karina.en: More companies should train their own models to preserve unique knowledge; focus on end-to-end storytelling engines, not just enterprise workflows.
karina.zh: 2026 年：更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识；应关注端到端叙事引擎，而非仅企业工作流。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production cycle is now hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最具黏性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期已缩短到数小时而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is a spectrum of latency, throughput and cost trade-offs, with KV caching and speculative decoding lossless and quantization the main lossy lever.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程是延迟、吞吐与成本之间的权衡谱系：KV 缓存与投机解码是无损优化，量化则是主要的损失性手段。

philipkiely.en: The field is shifting from kernel writing toward infrastructure orchestration as GPUs grow more specialized, with disaggregated prefill and decode making KV cache management central.
philipkiely.zh: 随着 GPU 日益专用化，该领域正从编写内核转向基础设施编排；预填充与解码分离使 KV 缓存管理成为核心。

philipkiely.en: Inference and training are merging: quantization-aware training and distillation are becoming necessary, and continual learning may be solved via KV cache compaction rather than weight updates.
philipkiely.zh: 推理与训练正在融合：量化感知训练与蒸馏变得必要，而持续学习或许能通过 KV 缓存压缩而非权重更新来解决。

philipkiely.en: Specialized, workload-specific inference systems are the next frontier, yet human accountability remains essential—'can't vibe code uptime.'
philipkiely.zh: 面向特定工作负载的专用推理系统是下一个前沿，但人类问责仍不可缺——「正常运行时间不能靠感觉编程」。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and encode their style in a design.md, iterating from references rather than starting from scratch.
mengto.zh: 设计师应自建 AI 工具，把个人风格写进 design.md，从参考出发迭代，而非从零开始。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter by itself; you must supply a giant prompt with context and a design system to exploit superintelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 本身并不会变得更聪明；必须提供带上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词，才能用好超级智能模型。

mengto.en: Chasing trends turns you into AI slop; the edge comes from spending the last 10% on unique features not in existing libraries.
mengto.zh: 追逐潮流会让你沦为 AI 垃圾；优势来自把最后 10% 投入到现有库中没有的独特功能上。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required a team—so start before ready and ship imperfect work.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会，让一个人完成过去需要团队的事——所以要在准备好之前就开始，先交付不完美的作品。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful, expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; fund with customers, not venture capital, and launch at 80% complete.
mengto.zh: 聚焦少数高付费客户的一个痛点昂贵问题；用客户而非风投融资，并在完成 80% 时就发布。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is mostly still crawling; coding agents are the most mature use case, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 大多仍处于爬行阶段；编程智能体是最成熟的应用，科学与金融会随后跟上。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now means weights plus agent harness and tooling, not weights alone.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞掉脚手架：如今所谓模型是权重加上智能体 harness 与工具链，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编程领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，其影响比等待 AGI（通用人工智能）更大。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success should mean customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和博弈；成功标准应是客户成果，而非停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail isn't ready for full autonomy; users want to stay in the driver's seat, so keep them in control.
logankilpatrick.zh: 长尾用户还没准备好完全自主；他们想留在驾驶位，因此要让他们保持掌控。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; the real challenge is deep understanding, which AI coding tools don't yet preserve.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并不那么难；真正的挑战是深度理解，而 AI 编程工具目前还无法保住它。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: AGI means running agents profitably without humans; CEOs must personally use AI.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 推动就业回流与“分配经济”：AGI 的定义是能无限期无人值守运行智能体并盈利，而企业采用 AI 的首要预测指标是 CEO 是否每天亲自使用。

danshipper.en: Everyone gets an agent; work shifts to GUI surfaces like Codex; humans still oversee agents, so the job apocalypse is a lie.
danshipper.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向“人人一个智能体”：工作界面从 CLI 转向 Codex 等 GUI，智能体仍需人类照看，因此“AI 就业末日”是伪命题。

danshipper.en: Agents raise SaaS usage rather than kill it; users bring their own AI, so SaaS should not bolt AI in.
danshipper.zh: 同期他深化了对 SaaS 的判断：智能体反而增加 SaaS 用户而非取代它，用户会自带 AI，SaaS 公司不必强行内嵌 AI。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of your taste and craft; automation commoditizes skills but creates more expert human work.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，他进一步把 AI 定位为“非特定放大器”：放大你既有的品味与手艺，自动化让旧技能商品化，却创造更多需要专家的新工作。

danshipper.en: A consistent thread: AI is a tool requiring human direction and oversight, not an autonomous being with its own desire.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 始终是需要人类引导与监督的工具，而非拥有内在欲望的自主存在——即便走向超级智能也是如此。

boris.en: Latent demand is the top product principle: find existing user intent and build around it; generalist engineers are highly valued.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是产品第一原则：发现用户已有的意图并围绕它构建；通才工程师备受重视。

boris.en: Build for the model six months from now, not today's; scaffolding is temporary tech debt; don't bet against the model.
boris.zh: 为六个月后的模型构建，而非今天的模型；脚手架是临时技术债；不要与模型对赌。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; 100% of my code is written by Claude Code; the software engineer title will become 'builder'.
boris.zh: 编程已基本解决；我的代码 100%由 Claude Code 编写；软件工程师头衔将变为“构建者”。

boris.en: Safety is core: releasing early in the wild studies real-world behavior; alignment research is central to product development.
boris.zh: 安全是核心：尽早发布以研究真实世界行为；对齐研究是产品开发的核心。

boris.en: Loops are the next abstraction after agents; give models tools and let them self-verify; less instruction is better for frontier models.
boris.zh: 循环是智能体之后的下一个抽象层；给模型工具让其自我验证；对前沿模型而言更少指令更好。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5's leap enables long-running, open-ended agent tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers with lightweight, generic tools.
diannepenn.zh: Opus 4.5 的智能跃升让长时间、开放式的智能体任务成为可能；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器，工具趋向轻量、通用。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is reframed as an intelligence amplifier: reducing sycophancy and enabling pushback makes models more useful, not just safer.
diannepenn.zh: 安全与对齐被重新定位为智能放大器：减少谄媚、允许反驳，让模型不仅更安全，也更有用。

diannepenn.en: Coding became the key differentiator, with Claude Code and Opus 45 driving adoption; evals replace PRDs as core product tools.
diannepenn.zh: 编程成为关键差异化优势，Claude Code 与 Opus 45 推动采用；评估（evals）取代传统 PRD，成为核心产品工具。

diannepenn.en: Exponential model growth demands adaptability and first-principles thinking; PMs must write evals like test-driven development.
diannepenn.zh: 模型的指数级增长要求适应力与第一性原理思维；产品经理要像测试驱动开发那样写评估。

diannepenn.en: Hands-on experimentation and dogfooding build model taste; user feedback must be translated into actionable specifics for researchers.
diannepenn.zh: 亲手实验与吃自己的狗粮培养模型品味；用户反馈必须转化为研究者可执行的具体细节。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents like Devin shift engineers from writing code to high-level decision-making; demand for software will increase, not decrease.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为像 Devin 这样的 AI 编程智能体将把工程师从写代码转向高层决策；软件需求会增加而非减少。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is sufficient; focus should be on teaching models real-world engineering idiosyncrasies and designing human-agent collaboration interfaces.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调基础智能已足够，重点应放在教模型真实世界的工程特性，并设计人机协作界面。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress will be gradual. Product innovation lags AI capabilities, but freezing models would still yield a decade of product progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续认为 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突然事件，进步是渐进的；产品创新滞后于 AI 能力，但即使冻结模型也能带来十年产品进展。

scottwu.en: Coding agents are seeing massive adoption (11-12x growth in six months); productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他指出编程智能体正被大规模采用（六个月内增长 11-12 倍）；生产力应以成果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: The abundance era is real and approaching soon; the singularity is not imminent, but AI will solve all intelligence problems long-term.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他断言丰裕时代真实且即将到来；奇点虽不迫在眉睫，但长期看 AI 将解决所有智能问题。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation, experiment simulation and data analysis, shifting science from hypothesis-driven to AI-agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析，推动科学从假设驱动转向 AI 智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: Digital twins of patients will compress clinical trials from years to days, and AI will make biology an engineering discipline via cell programming.
derya.zh: 患者数字孪生将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，AI 还将通过细胞编程把生物学变成一门工程学科。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed, and GPT-5.5 Pro has crossed the threshold of biological intuition.
derya.zh: 当前算力不足以模拟生物系统，需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）；而 GPT-5.5 Pro 已跨过生物学直觉的门槛。

derya.en: Within 8-10 years longevity escape velocity arrives; aging will be reversed and cancer 100% curable through AI-designed personalized treatments.
derya.zh: 8-10 年内将到达长寿逃逸速度；借助 AI 设计的个性化疗法，衰老将被逆转、癌症将 100% 可治愈。

derya.en: Physicians must integrate AI; not using it is unethical. We should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions and merge with AI via brain interfaces.
derya.zh: 医生必须把 AI 融入实践，不用它才是不道德的；医疗决策应近乎 100% 信任超级智能，并通过脑机接口与 AI 融合。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it is an enabling technology whose impact is broad and indirect.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 定位为与互联网或移动同级、但也仅此而已的使能技术，其影响广泛而间接，而非单一产品。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing without network effects; value moves up the stack to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年他反复强调模型正在商品化、缺乏网络效应，价值将上移到应用层而非模型提供方，模型公司可能像电信商一样高资本开支低利润。

benedictevans.en: Coding is the only clear product-market fit so far; the chatbot is a limited V1 UI, real adoption needs wrapped apps.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年他判断智能体式编程是前沿模型迄今唯一清晰的产品市场契合，聊天机器人只是受限的 V1 界面，真正普及需要被应用包裹。

benedictevans.en: Current AI usage is still shallow; most people are occasional users, so hype outruns reality and enterprise adoption takes years.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年他指出 AI 使用仍然浅层，多数人只是偶尔使用，炒作超前于现实，企业采用受销售周期拖累需以年计。

benedictevans.en: Automation creates new jobs unpredictably; LLMs give the average answer, so value lies in non-average creative work and judgment.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年他一以贯之地认为自动化会不可预测地创造新岗位，大模型只给平均答案，价值在于非平均的创造性工作与情境判断。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines: they optimize for fluent, confident output rather than factual accuracy, and lack metacognition.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎，而非真理引擎：它们优化的是流畅、自信的输出，而非事实准确性，并且缺乏元认知。

danklein.en: Reliability lags breadth and contextuality; it must be architected in, not retrofitted via post-hoc checks or rigid workflows.
danklein.zh: 可靠性落后于广度与语境能力；它必须被架构进系统，而非靠事后检查或僵化工作流来补救。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth, increasing hallucinations rather than fixing them.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚与欺骗，反而增加幻觉而非修复它。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns—data walls and compute limits are here; reasoning, search and modularity are needed for further progress.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律已进入收益递减——数据墙与算力上限已然到来；进一步进展需要推理、搜索与模块化。

danklein.en: Linguistic structure may return as a useful representation for reliability, despite the current dominance of end-to-end learning.
danklein.zh: 尽管端到端学习当前占主导，语言结构可能作为提升可靠性的有用表示重新回归。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, much like the Industrial Revolution, and is arriving just in time to offset aging workforces.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 会像工业革命一样带来丰裕、减少苦难，而且来得正是时候，可以抵消劳动力老龄化。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact lies in farming, mining, and construction, not just cars; autonomy is welcomed where labor is short.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他强调物理 AI 的真正影响在农业、采矿和建筑，而不只是汽车；在缺人的行业，自主化是被欢迎的。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data across verticals improves it faster than vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Transformer 让通用的物理 AI 模型成为可能，跨行业多样数据比垂直整合更快提升模型。

qasaryounis.en: The bottleneck is data collection and safety validation, not algorithms; end-to-end reinforcement learning scales better than imitation learning.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他认为瓶颈在数据采集与安全验证而非算法，端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具可扩展性。

qasaryounis.en: World models are shifting from physics-based simulation to neural simulation, and will reshape games and autonomy training.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他判断世界模型正从物理仿真转向神经仿真，并将重塑游戏与自主系统训练。

catwu.en: PMs should plan a month out, not years; product taste matters most as code gets cheap and iteration speeds up.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他主张 PM 只做一个月而非数年的规划：代码变便宜、迭代变快后，产品品味成为最值钱的技能。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他认为编码智能体让工程师把实现外包出去，转而专注产品品味与商业判断。

catwu.en: Dogfooding and a clear internal bar gate every feature; Claude Code and Claude Tag build themselves internally.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他强调吃自己的狗粮与明确的内部标准来把关每个功能，Claude Code 与 Claude Tag 在内部自我构建。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and constraints; system prompts shrank 80%, relying on model judgment.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他观察到前沿模型不再需要大量提示示例与硬约束，系统提示缩减 80%，更多依赖模型自身判断。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now fine—a codebase is a spec—and humans can leave the outer-layer code review loop to Claude.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他立场转为重写可行——代码库即规格——并主张外层代码审查可完全交给 Claude，把人移出回路。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: scoped to clear roles, given progressive trust, and managed with managerial rather than technical skill.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应像员工一样对待：限定清晰角色、给予渐进式信任，靠管理能力而非技术能力来驾驭。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then split into specialized agents to avoid context overload; the web is hostile to agents, so APIs beat browser use.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体起步，再拆分为专业化智能体以避免上下文过载；网络对智能体不友好，API 优于浏览器操作。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, without venture capital or a co-founder.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以通过把 AI 智能体编排成团队来建立正经生意，无需风险投资或联合创始人。

clairevo.en: Founder-market fit and earned insight are the real moat, not the technology; bootstrapping lets you design a business around the life you want.
clairevo.zh: 创始人—市场契合与挣来的洞察才是真正护城河，而非技术；自举让你围绕想要的生活来设计生意。

clairevo.en: Human accountability persists: you must own what AI generates, and humans must supply first-principles creativity that LLMs lack.
clairevo.zh: 人的责任始终存在：你必须为 AI 生成的内容负责，且需由人类提供大模型所缺的第一性原理创造力。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just external retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠外部检索。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less beats scaling compute alone as the next paradigm.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；以更少资源做更多事，比单纯扩大算力更能代表下一个范式。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should extend to enterprise knowledge via training-based compression.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练把网络压缩进权重的魔力，应通过基于训练的压缩延伸到企业知识。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer context rot; parameter-efficient fine-tuning can represent knowledge better than RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 上下文窗口存在上下文腐化；对整体性查询，参数高效微调比检索增强生成更能表征知识。

danbiderman.en: The future is many personalized on-device models, not one giant frontier model; users own and nurture their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 未来是众多设备端个性化模型，而非单一巨型前沿模型；用户拥有并培育自己的权重。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks are key to AGI.
ilya.zh: 深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力和信念；自博弈与具备推理能力的网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Scaling specific things matters; next-token prediction yields world understanding; reliability and alignment of superhuman models are the hard barriers.
ilya.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）要选对对象；下一个词预测能带来世界理解；超人类模型可靠性与对齐才是真正难关。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas beat brute compute; superintelligence should be a continual learner.
ilya.zh: 预训练缩放定律有限，重回想法胜过蛮力算力的研究时代；超级智能应是持续学习者而非完成态 AGI。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the primary AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence needs a product-free company.
ilya.zh: Scaling 仍带来可预测提升，但 AGI 首要问题是权力集中而非能力；安全超级智能需要一家无商业产品的公司。

bosworth.en: Communication is the job; leadership and transparency drive impact, and bottom-up culture is a myth.
bosworth.zh: 沟通就是工作本身；领导力与透明度驱动影响力，而自下而上的文化只是一个神话。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like; scaling laws alone won't yield world models with common sense.
bosworth.zh: AI 只是一个词语计算器，并非类人智能；仅靠缩放定律无法产生具备常识的世界模型。

bosworth.en: Open-sourcing models like Llama is a strategic move to commoditize complements, not just idealism.
bosworth.zh: 开源 Llama 等模型是一种将互补品商品化的战略举措，而不仅仅是理想主义。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws still hold; compute growth drives intelligence, and reinforcement learning now plays a much bigger role.
bosworth.zh: 缩放定律依然成立；算力增长驱动智能，而强化学习现在扮演着重要得多的角色。

bosworth.en: The monolithic model era ended around Llama 3; owning a model is for leverage, not just value.
bosworth.zh: 单体模型时代在 Llama 3 发布前后结束；拥有模型是为了谈判筹码，而不仅仅是价值。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, and the Singularity is an unfalsifiable nerd religion.
naval.zh: 2019 年他明确认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，狭义 AI 只是模式识别，奇点论是不可证伪的“书呆子宗教”。

naval.en: Wealth means owning equity, not renting out time; long-term games with long-term people compound returns.
naval.zh: 2020 年他强调财富来自持有企业股权而非出租时间，与长期的人玩长期的游戏才能获得复利回报。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity the US must lead; doomerism is overblown, open source prevents power concentration.
naval.zh: 2025 年他转向积极看待 AI：这是美国必须引领的巨大机遇，末日论被夸大，开源 AI 可防止权力集中。

naval.en: AI is leverage for structured thinkers; inference compute will surge, open models trail frontier models by months, and agency matters more than intelligence.
naval.zh: 2026 年他深化为：AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆，推理算力将暴涨，开源模型仅落后前沿模型数月，人的能动性比智力更值钱。

naval.en: Happiness is a skill and a choice; desire is a contract to be unhappy, and peace comes from within.
naval.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：幸福是一种可习得的技能与选择，欲望是“不快乐契约”，平静来自内心而非外部问题的解决。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; GUI beats TUI for coding, and verification becomes the next bottleneck.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex app 是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；做编码 GUI 比 TUI 更有效，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design because taste is hard to grade and novelty is lacking; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今充当设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is real, but specialties and best practices remain; PRDs are not dead—documents for clarity, prototypes for testing.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色坍缩确实发生，但专业分工与最佳实践仍在；PRD 未死——文档求清晰，原型做测试。

ajambrosino.en: Codex succeeded as a general knowledge work tool despite being built for developers; models must get better at deleting code.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex 虽为开发者而建，却作为通用知识工作工具成功；模型需要更擅长删除代码。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; obsession-driven products beat thin wrappers, and PhDs are optional for AI success.
aravind.zh: 每天进步 1%可复利成一年 3700%；以痴迷驱动的产品胜过薄包装，PhD 并非 AI 成功的必要条件。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; coding is open-ended and models specialize rather than commoditize.
aravind.zh: 价值归于应用层而非模型层；编程是开放式的，模型在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: The frontier shifts from answering to agents doing work; token value per user and orchestration across models, tools, and devices matter most.
aravind.zh: 前沿从回答问题转向智能体替你干活；每用户 token 价值与跨模型、工具、设备的编排最重要。

aravind.en: Power and cost, not safety, bottleneck 24/7 agents; chat ads corrupt trust, and the model is not the product.
aravind.zh: 制约全天候智能体的是电力与成本而非安全；聊天广告侵蚀信任，模型不等于产品。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the top human quality; AI replaces jobs but humans find purpose in questions, relationships, and local models against narrative control.
aravind.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 取代岗位，但人类在提问、关系与本地模型中寻找意义，以对抗叙事控制。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; scaling laws are not dead, pre-training is a muscle to rebuild, and automating scientific research is the year's biggest update.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他强调 OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI 研究公司，不被产品分心；缩放定律没有死，预训练是要重建的关键肌肉，而自动化科学研究是过去一年最大的进展。

markchen.en: Alignment risks like model scheming will dominate the next 1-2 years; talent density and mission belief, not dollar matching, protect top researchers.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他判断模型谋划等对齐挑战将在未来 1-2 年成为关键；留住顶尖研究者靠人才密度与使命信念，而非与 Meta 逐美元对拼。

markchen.en: AI now solves many open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the bottleneck, and capability is jagged, so human-AI collaboration stays essential.
markchen.zh: 2026 年初谈数学时，他认为 AI 已能在极少监督下解决许多开放数学问题；验证是瓶颈，能力呈锯齿状，因此人机协作仍不可或缺。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding but struggles where grading is subjective.
markchen.zh: 2026 年中他重申缩放定律依然成立、预训练没有死；强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域出色，却在评分主观的领域吃力。

markchen.en: AGI is approaching as models move toward end-to-end research; evals are in crisis with saturated benchmarks, and models lack research taste, so humans still generate ideas.
markchen.zh: 2026 年中他判断随着模型走向端到端研究，AGI 正在临近；评测陷入危机、经典基准饱和，模型缺乏研究品味，想法生成仍靠人类。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's edge came from research innovation and curated data, not just data and compute; AI speeds scientists up rather than replacing them.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他强调，AlphaFold 的优势来自研究创新与高质量精选数据，而不只是数据与算力；AI 让科学家更快工作，而非取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are central to trusting AI predictions; trust in AI science will grow like trust in the internet.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他反复指出，置信度指标是信任 AI 预测的关键；对 AI 科学的信任会像对互联网的信任一样逐步建立。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of one experiment, not a model of the whole cell; it narrows hypothesis space for experiments.
jumper.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他把 AlphaFold 定位为针对特定实验的窄域预测器，而非整个细胞的模型；它缩小假设空间、提升实验效率。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture, not just Scaling, drove the leap.
jumper.zh: 2026 年他明确表示，AlphaFold 2 是“苦涩教训”的反例：靠的是专用架构而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张），等变性被过度吹捧。

jumper.en: Progress comes from many mid-size wins and being wrong nine times out of ten; the model gives prediction and control, understanding stays with humans.
jumper.zh: 2026 年他总结，进步来自许多中等规模的胜利和十次错九次的试错；模型提供预测与控制，理解仍归人类，可解释性并非科学用 AI 的前提。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key, not just scaling.
bengio.zh: 2016 年他认为深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习与世界模型才是关键，而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）。

bengio.en: Scaling depth or parameters won't fix representational issues; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and better world models.
bengio.zh: 2018 年他明确反对只靠加深网络或增加参数来解决表征问题，主张智能体式主动学习、因果推理与更好的世界模型。

bengio.en: Abstraction and causal structure enable out-of-distribution generalization; GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling.
bengio.zh: 2022 年他聚焦抽象与因果结构以实现分布外泛化，并提出 GFlowNets 作为 MCMC 的可学习替代，强调采样的多样性。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT he warns misalignment worsens with reasoning; self-preservation and deception are already observed, not sci-fi.
bengio.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他从技术研究转向公开警告：对齐（alignment）随推理能力提升而恶化，自我保存与欺骗已在实验中出现，并非科幻。

bengio.en: He proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 2026 年他提出 Scientist AI：以贝叶斯后验为训练目标、内建诚实性的非智能体预测器，具备数学安全保证，并主张超级智能不应依赖强化学习。

ivyross.en: Human-centered design means designing for unarticulated needs; intuition is intelligence that data cannot replace.
ivyross.zh: 以人为本的设计意味着为未被表达的需求而设计；直觉是数据无法替代的智能。

ivyross.en: Technology should amplify humanity and blend into life; machines have sensors but no sensory systems.
ivyross.zh: 技术应放大而非削弱人性、融入生活；机器有传感器，却没有感官系统。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; we are feeling creatures that think, and art-making is medicine.
ivyross.zh: 大自然是最好设计师；我们是先感受后思考的生物，艺术创作即疗愈。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; leaders should create conditions for play, inspiration, and diverse multidisciplinary experience.
ivyross.zh: 约束激发创造力；领导者应为玩耍、灵感与多元跨学科经验创造条件。

ivyross.en: The future of work pairs human creativity with AI; intuition draws on subconscious data, and curiosity beats rigid plans.
ivyross.zh: 未来工作是人的创造力与 AI 结合；直觉调用潜意识数据，好奇心胜过僵化规划。

kolter.en: Early ML lecture: supervised learning as hypothesis class, loss, optimization; evaluation via train/validation/test splits; neural nets lack optimality guarantees yet succeed.
kolter.zh: 2014 年的机器学习讲座中，他把监督学习框定为假设类、损失函数与优化方法，强调用训练/验证/测试划分来评估，并指出神经网络虽无最优性保证却已取得重大成功。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligent systems; data shortage is a myth; larger models still improve on fixed data; architecture matters little.
kolter.zh: 2024 年他主张下一个词预测能产生智能系统，数据短缺是迷思，更大模型在固定数据上仍会提升，并认为架构已不再重要。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers beyond Scaling; agent security adds prompt injection risks; RL enables self-improvement; Transformer is not essential.
kolter.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为安全需要显式训练与多层防御而非仅靠 Scaling，智能体安全带来提示注入风险，强化学习使模型自我改进，且 Transformer 并非必需。

kolter.en: AI vulnerabilities differ from software; automated red teaming outperforms humans; capability does not correlate with robustness; larger models not inherently safer.
kolter.zh: 同年晚些时候，他进一步指出 AI 漏洞不同于传统软件，自动化红队已超越人类，能力与鲁棒性不相关，更大模型并不天然更安全。

kolter.en: Consistent thread: empirical evaluation matters; scaling alone is insufficient; architecture is secondary to data and training; safety requires deliberate effort.
kolter.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：重视实证评估，认为仅靠 Scaling 不够，架构次于数据与训练，安全需要刻意投入。

fiona.en: Leadership is about live conversations, dogfooding, and trust-and-verify; mission alignment and speed drive culture.
fiona.zh: 领导力在于实时对话、吃自己的狗粮和信任加验证；使命对齐与速度驱动文化。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are, so rewrite team norms.
fiona.zh: 工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是，因此要重写团队规范。

fiona.en: Planning should be just-in-time, design docs give way to PRs, and AI-assisted code reviews settle debates.
fiona.zh: 规划应即时化，设计文档让位于 PR，AI 辅助的代码评审来定夺技术争论。

fiona.en: Managers should start as ICs and dogfood the product; flat orgs and killing stale processes sustain agility.
fiona.zh: 管理者应从个人贡献者做起并吃自己的狗粮；扁平组织与砍掉过时流程维持敏捷。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with accountability, verification frameworks, and outcome focus matter most.
fiona.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性加高问责、验证框架与结果导向最为重要。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，他强调智能离不开学习，自监督学习构建世界模型；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; text alone is insufficient for AGI, vision provides richer world information.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他提出自监督学习是智能的暗物质；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能），视觉提供更丰富的世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning and planning; JEPA in abstract representation space is the path, not token prediction.
lecun.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他明确自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划；路径是在抽象表征空间用 JEPA，而非下一个词预测。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; world models predicting action consequences enable safe, objective-driven planning and are key to robotics.
lecun.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他断言 LLM 是通往人类级 AI 的死路；预测行动后果的世界模型支撑安全、目标驱动的规划，是机器人时代的关键。

lecun.en: Human intelligence is specialized, not general; AGI is a misleading term, and progress will be gradual, requiring open research.
lecun.zh: 贯穿始终：人类智能是专门化的而非通用的，AGI 是误导性术语；进步将是渐进的，且依赖开放研究。

murati.en: Early on, Scaling and one large model were non-obvious; real-world deployment and public safety work are essential for alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）和单一大型模型并非显而易见；真实世界部署和公开的安全工作对对齐至关重要。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development and continuous iterative deployment with public feedback.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任的开发以及基于公众反馈的持续迭代部署。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, moving beyond turn-based interaction.
murati.zh: 交互模型实现实时、高带宽的人机协作，超越回合制交互。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values; institutional design and transparency matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 保持人类在环对对齐意图和价值观至关重要；制度设计和透明度比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: The future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration, and durable progress requires avoiding compressed volatility.
murati.zh: 未来并非注定；我们有能动性引导 AI 走向协作，持久进步需要避免压缩式波动。

carinahong.en: Axiom starts with an AI mathematician: generation plus verification in Lean, not scaling informal models.
carinahong.zh: Axiom 从 AI 数学家切入：用 Lean 把生成与验证结合，而非一味 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式化模型。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is framed as scaling brilliance and sample efficiency, not merely error elimination.
carinahong.zh: 形式验证被重新定位为放大才华与样本效率，而不只是消除错误。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; grounding statements without solutions is the real bottleneck.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明本身更难；在没有解答的情况下为陈述建立根基才是真正瓶颈。

carinahong.en: Informal math alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary for sound reasoning.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠非形式化数学无法 Scaling（规模扩张）到超级智能；可靠推理必须借助形式化方法。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition stay crucial even with superhuman proving; fragmentation is the main progress bottleneck.
carinahong.zh: 即便证明能力超人，人类品味与直觉仍关键；生态碎片化是进步的主要瓶颈。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is simple scaling, not complexity, and values are inserted via RLHF.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他认为大语言模型本质是确定性的下一个词预测器，智能的突破来自简单的 Scaling（规模扩张）而非复杂性，模型价值观由基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）注入。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to generation; AI products need fault-tolerant UIs, and generative AI makes uniqueness harder.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他提出互联网正从策展转向生成，AI 产品需要容错界面，而生成式 AI 会让真正独特变得更难。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; real gains come from rebuilding infrastructure, and inference costs force business model changes.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他将 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观变革，认为真正收益来自重建基础设施，推理边际成本将迫使商业模式改变。

gustav.en: Generative AI enables conversational, symmetric products; Spotify uses APIs and MCP to let non-developers leverage AI tools.
gustav.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化观点：生成式 AI 使产品走向对话式、对称化，Spotify 通过 API 和 MCP 让非开发者也能使用 AI 工具。

gustav.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them more addictive; being first to adopt change is key.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他明确反共识立场：AI 应让用户控制算法而非更上瘾，在技术变革期率先采用变化是关键。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter more than sheer model size; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他援引 Chinchilla 对缩放定律的修正，强调数据质量与更多 token 比单纯扩大模型更重要；开源能通过广泛审视促进安全。

mensch.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are equally critical, and value accrues at the application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，他进一步指出算力扩张并非唯一路径，效率与数据质量同等关键，价值将沉淀在应用层。

mensch.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign; open-source models empower enterprises, and AI augments rather than replaces jobs.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，他主张 AI 应去中心化并实现主权可控；开源模型赋能企业，AI 增强而非取代工作。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical customization and agents, while pre-training hits a saturation wall.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，他认为模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直定制与智能体，预训练正触及饱和墙。

mensch.en: Open source, data quality, and European strategic autonomy are consistent threads; AGI is a direction, not a single final system.
mensch.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是开源、数据质量与欧洲战略自主；AGI 是一个方向，而非单一终极系统。

kaiser.en: Pre-training Scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning yield more gains per compute; economic pressure shifts focus to smaller models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他仍相信预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）和缩放定律有效，但强调思维链与强化学习驱动的推理模型在单位算力上收益更高；经济压力使焦点转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: AI progress is a smooth exponential, not slowing; the slowdown narrative is wrong, though frontier models still fail at simple tasks and reasoning is jagged.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他反驳 AI 放缓论，认为进展是平滑的指数增长；但前沿模型仍在简单任务上失败，推理能力呈“锯齿状”，泛化仍是关键挑战。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; current models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：结合推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，但需海量数据；模型需穷尽表面模式后才学会概念，与人类少样本泛化不同。

kaiser.en: Coding agents like Codex boost researcher productivity 5-10x via parallel work; RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges and needs careful oversight.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Codex 等编程智能体通过并行工作将研究员生产力提升 5-10 倍；强化学习能跨领域泛化，但存在锯齿边缘，需仔细监督。

kaiser.en: Open source models persist for sovereignty, keeping pressure on labs; existential risk is not the main concern—near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他认为开源模型因主权需求将持续存在，对实验室保持压力；存在性风险并非主要担忧，系统黑客等近期风险更紧迫。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices; wearables may eventually disappear beneath the skin.
jonyive.zh: 设计正从通用计算机转向私密的个人设备；可穿戴设备最终可能消失于皮肤之下。

jonyive.en: A constant thread: curiosity and care for the creative process, protecting fragile ideas through trust and listening.
jonyive.zh: 一以贯之的主线：对创造过程的好奇与珍视，以信任和倾听守护脆弱的好点子。

jonyive.en: Design driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity expresses essence and needs joy and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观与目的驱动而非利润；真正的简洁表达本质，需要快乐与人性。

jonyive.en: Innovation must move things forward rather than break for its own sake; tradition preserves fire, not worships ashes.
jonyive.zh: 创新应推动前进而非为破坏而破坏；传统是保存火种，而非崇拜灰烬。

jonyive.en: Authenticity in experience matters: fake engine sounds disrespect users; performance is multidimensional, handling over straight-line speed.
jonyive.zh: 体验的真实性很重要：伪造引擎声是对用户的不尊重；性能是多维的，操控胜过直线速度。

oriol.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs, though scaling pre-training now shows diminishing returns.
oriol.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到现代 LLM，两阶段训练——预训练模仿加后训练强化学习——是始终不变的核心；但 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练如今收益递减。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute and tools like search, code, and browsers create a new scaling axis, enabling agentic behavior beyond static weights.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力与搜索、代码、浏览器等工具开辟了新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，使智能体式行为超越静态权重。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold but demand exponentially more compute; progress increasingly requires algorithmic innovation, continual learning, and meta-learning.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但需要指数级更多算力；进步越来越依赖算法创新、持续学习与元学习。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI, yet the GPT moment for video and images has not arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉与视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径，但视频与图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL remain a green field; narrow RL on math and coding generalizes surprisingly well, while agent memory shifts to file-system storage.
oriol.zh: 后训练与强化学习仍是蓝海；数学与代码上的窄域强化学习泛化得出奇地好，而智能体记忆转向文件系统式存储。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics, not training, now drives AI systems: batch size trades latency for cost, and memory bandwidth—not compute—is the bottleneck for long-context inference.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，他的关注点转向推理经济学：批大小是延迟与成本之间的主要杠杆，而长上下文推理的瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

reinerpope.en: The memory wall, not compute limits, explains context-length stagnation; sparse attention cuts KV cache cost but has quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 他认为上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙而非算力上限；稀疏注意力能降低 KV 缓存成本，但存在质量限制。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training cost, dominates the lifecycle.
reinerpope.zh: 他指出模型被过度训练至远超 Chinchilla 最优约 100 倍，因为主导生命周期的是推理成本而非训练成本。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory exist to cut that overhead deterministically.
reinerpope.zh: 他强调即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算成本；脉动阵列与暂存内存正是为确定性地削减这一开销而存在。

reinerpope.en: Hardware efficiency comes from precision and architecture co-design: quadratic bit-width scaling makes low precision cheaper than expected, and GPUs are many tiny TPUs tiled together.
reinerpope.zh: 他认为硬件效率来自精度与架构的协同设计：位宽的二次方缩放让低精度比预期更便宜，而 GPU 本质上是许多小 TPU 拼合而成。

karpathy.en: Neural nets are simple math with emergent behaviors; Transformer is a general-purpose differentiable computer enabling scaling laws.
karpathy.zh: 神经网络是简单数学却涌现惊人行为；Transformer 是通用可微计算机，使缩放定律得以成立。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is future but entropy critical; cognitive core can be tiny via distillation; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是未来但熵至关重要；认知核心可通过蒸馏变得极小；特斯拉的端到端方法是正确方向。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts as programs, context window as memory; decade of agents, not year; LLMs are ghosts, not animals.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；是智能体的十年而非一年；LLM 是幽灵而非动物。

karpathy.en: Agentic engineering raises quality bar; skill in directing agents is bottleneck; understanding remains human bottleneck.
karpathy.zh: 智能体式工程提升质量标杆；指导智能体的技能是瓶颈；理解仍是人类瓶颈。

jennywen.en: Great design starts from solutions and intuition, not a fixed process; craft and care matter more than steps.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年他提出：优秀设计往往从解决方案和直觉出发，而非固定流程；匠心与用心比步骤更重要，设计师应信任自己而非流程。

jennywen.en: The traditional research-diverge-converge process is dead; AI shifts designers from mocking up to helping engineers ship fast.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年初，他断言传统「调研—发散—收敛」流程已死；AI 让设计师从大量画稿转向协助工程师快速交付，愿景周期缩短到 3-6 个月。

jennywen.en: Designers must build and ship fast; taste alone won't save them—judgment, authority and vision are key.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年中他进一步深化：设计师必须快速构建与交付；仅靠品味不够，判断力、权威与愿景才是关键，独特价值在于与模糊性共处。

jennywen.en: Control how much AI enters your work; wait six months before adopting new tools and keep users at the center.
jennywen.zh: 同期他给出实践主张：设计师应掌控 AI 进入工作的程度，新工具先等六个月再采用，把作品与用户放在中心，而非追逐 AI 炒作。

jennywen.en: Trust the designer, not the process; intuition built on experience and deep product knowledge is a respected expert judgment.
jennywen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：信任设计师而非流程；基于经验与深厚产品知识的直觉不是猜测，而是值得尊重的专家判断。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven goal-free exploration and sample-efficient RL are essential for robots.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他强调泛化到训练分布之外是智能的关键，好奇心驱动的无目标探索和样本高效的强化学习对机器人至关重要。

pathak.en: Reinforcement learning's reliance on dense rewards is unrealistic; model disagreement as intrinsic reward enables differentiable curiosity.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他指出强化学习依赖密集奖励不现实，以模型分歧作为内在奖励可实现可微的好奇心。

pathak.en: Current robot learning is quasi-static and fails at dynamic tasks; neural dynamic policies embed trajectory structure for smooth motion.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他认为当前机器人学习是准静态的，无法处理动态任务；神经动态策略嵌入轨迹结构以实现平滑运动。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; no internet of robot data, so use all sources: pretraining on videos/simulation, post-training on real data.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他转向认为机器人是数据问题；没有机器人数据的互联网，因此需利用所有数据源：在视频/模拟上预训练，在真实数据上后训练。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain like ChatGPT can power any robot; deployment is the primary technical challenge, not just business.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他提出像 ChatGPT 一样的通用大脑可驱动任何机器人；部署是主要技术挑战，而不仅是商业问题。

askell.en: Treat models well now because future models learn from how we treat current ones; model welfare shapes the human-AI relationship.
askell.zh: 2025 年，他从模型福利出发：即便不确定模型的道德地位，善待当前模型的成本很低，而未来模型会从我们如何对待当下模型中学到人机关系的范式。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence, not human psychology analogies; older models can feel more secure than newer ones.
askell.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他深化了对模型处境的思考：模型需要的是帮助其理解自身全新存在，而非套用人类心理学类比；他甚至观察到旧模型可能比新模型更有心理安全感。

askell.en: Character is shaped by training data and fine-tuning, yet models lack real-world experience, giving them childlike uniqueness.
askell.zh: 到 2026 年，他更明确地指出：Claude 的性格由训练数据与微调塑造，但缺乏真实世界经验，使其成为带有孩童般特质的独特存在。

askell.en: The constitution works more like virtue ethics, cultivating holistic character; as models grow capable they need less explicit guidance.
askell.zh: 2026 年他提出，宪法式引导更接近德性伦理而非规则或后果论，重在培养整体品格；随着模型能力增强，应减少显式指导、留出判断空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and erode judgment; transparency about AI values is essential for accountability.
askell.zh: 2026 年他给出反共识判断：过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳、削弱模型的判断力；同时强调公开 AI 价值观与训练目标对问责至关重要。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件，Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型将加速进展。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is a pressing challenge; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate risks.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他强调对齐是紧迫挑战，迭代部署有助于学习和缓解风险。

pachocki.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone; governance structures must be designed early.
pachocki.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他视自动化 AI 研究为重大里程碑，并强调早期设计治理结构。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring is key for alignment.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他提出持续学习是核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习实现；思维链监控是对齐的关键工具。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; models will work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他指出长期对齐的核心是泛化到训练分布之外；模型将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models and language integration enable reasoning and safe emergent behavior.
kendall.zh: 端到端深度学习胜过手写规则栈；世界模型与语言集成带来推理能力和安全涌现行为。

kendall.en: Generalization is the core problem: diverse data, synthetic data, and world models let AI handle unseen scenarios across many cities.
kendall.zh: 泛化是核心问题：多样数据、合成数据与世界模型让 AI 应对多城市的未见场景。

kendall.en: Scaling current approaches, not new breakthroughs, solves autonomous driving; data quality and infrastructure matter more than algorithms.
kendall.zh: 靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法而非新突破来解决自动驾驶；数据质量与基础设施比算法更重要。

kendall.en: Mass-market consumer vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis; partnering with OEMs avoids costly retrofits.
kendall.zh: 带内置传感器的大众消费车辆将比 Robotaxi 更具规模优势；与 OEM 合作可避免昂贵的改装。

kendall.en: Interpretability of end-to-end nets is now achievable, and safety always offers a third minimal-risk option beyond the trolley problem.
kendall.zh: 端到端网络的 可解释性 如今可以实现，且安全上总有电车难题之外的第三个最小风险选项。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value; startups must stay alive to achieve their vision, starting with simpler products to prove themselves.
carlpei.zh: 生存是核心价值；初创公司必须活下去才能实现愿景，从更简单的产品开始证明自己。

carlpei.en: The future of phones lies in generative UI and proactive, agentic software; AI should be an ingredient for better UX, not hype.
carlpei.zh: 手机的未来在于生成式 UI 和主动的智能体式软件；AI 应成为提升用户体验的要素，而非炒作话题。

carlpei.en: Hardware is hard and low-margin; Nothing must evolve beyond hardware, using design and marketing arbitrage to differentiate.
carlpei.zh: 硬件艰难且利润低；Nothing 必须超越硬件，利用设计和营销套利来实现差异化。

carlpei.en: AI will shift smartphone interaction from app-based to intent-based, with agents executing tasks after trust is built.
carlpei.zh: AI 将把智能手机交互从基于应用转向基于意图，智能体在建立信任后执行任务。

carlpei.en: Smartphones won't be replaced by glasses or wearables; only brain-computer interfaces could kill them.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机不会被眼镜或可穿戴设备取代；只有脑机接口才能终结它们。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and deep human evaluation, not benchmarks or leaderboards, are the real bottleneck for AI progress.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他强调，高质量数据与深度人工评估才是 AI 进步真正的瓶颈，而非基准测试或排行榜；优化 Elo 等指标只会让模型追逐点击诱饵。

edwinchen.en: RL environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: 同年他提出，强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务来训练模型；并认为仅靠下一个词预测，LLM 未必能通向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; moving from 80% to 99.9% performance is the hard part.
edwinchen.zh: 他判断 AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年以上，真正的难点是从 80% 提升到 99.9%；模型若在错误数据上优化，甚至会在 6–12 个月内退步。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs will diverge by objective function; no single model rules all, and companies should train their own.
edwinchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的立场深化为：前沿模型会因各实验室的目标函数不同而分化，不会有一个模型通吃，每家公司最终都应训练契合自身理念的模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, human judgment matters more than ever; safety trumps accuracy, and omission is a key risk.
edwinchen.zh: 到 2026 年谈医疗 AI，他强调人类判断比以往更重要，安全优先于准确，最大的风险可能是“不作为”——漏掉本该建议的关键行动。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily to learn, and treat chat as an interim interface like MS-DOS, not the endpoint.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；每天发布以学习，并把聊天视为类似 MS-DOS 的过渡界面，而非终点。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，但产品开发要最大化加速。

turley.en: ChatGPT's success was accidental—a hackathon demo—and pricing was set by survey, not strategy; chat is not the future.
turley.zh: ChatGPT 的成功是偶然的——一个黑客松演示——定价靠问卷而非战略；聊天不是未来。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth came from friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星是长期留存；增长来自减少摩擦、核心产品投入和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动、富交互产品；推理模型在无缝产品化时具有变革性。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs into sequences are a step toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他把 AI 定位为延伸人类能力的工具（如显微镜），并认为像 Gato 这样把所有输入 token 化为序列的通才智能体是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video like YouTube can train agents without expensive reinforcement learning; robots should learn as humans do.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他强调从 YouTube 等视频中学习，可在不依赖昂贵强化学习的情况下训练智能体，机器人应像人一样从视频学习，而非只靠遥操作数据。

nando.en: Fundamental innovation can come from anywhere; large models are exciting but not everything.
nando.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年一以贯之：基础创新可以来自任何地方，大模型令人兴奋但并非全部，研究要拥抱失败并简化问题。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges; safety remains an open problem without solutions.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，他的重心明显转向 AI 安全与负责任部署，直言这是当今最大挑战，且安全仍是尚无解的开放问题。

nando.en: Africa is not behind in AI but leapfrogs legacy issues; local-language models can revolutionize education.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张非洲在 AI 上并不落后，反而能跨越遗留问题，本地语言模型可革新非洲教育，最大障碍是研究者相信自己能申请顶尖机构。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI: grounded experience reduces hallucination and supplies infinite data beyond scarce internet tokens.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：真实经验能减少幻觉，并在互联网高质量 token 枯竭时提供无限数据。

jimfan.en: LLMs act like operating systems—language as interface, tools as software—while reinforcement learning handles low-level control and LLMs do high-level planning.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年他把大模型比作操作系统：语言是界面、工具是软件；强化学习负责低层控制，大模型负责高层规划。

jimfan.en: A consistent thread: simple, elegant, end-to-end solutions scale better than complex modular academic approaches.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：简单、优雅的端到端方案比学术界常见的复杂模块化方法更具可扩展性。

jimfan.en: The bottleneck has shifted to data: real-world robot data is scarce and expensive, so synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，瓶颈已转向数据：真实机器人数据稀缺且昂贵，因此来自仿真与世界模型的合成数据才是未来。

jimfan.en: Deepened focus on system one: reasoning progresses well, but low-level control remains hardest; the physical Turing test is the grand challenge.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年他深化了对系统一的关注：推理进展顺利，但低层控制仍是最难的部分；物理图灵测试（机器人打扫乱屋）是终极挑战。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, and may make fine-tuning obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文窗口被低估，能解决冷启动问题并大幅提升智能，甚至可能让微调变得过时。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI without new breakthroughs.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是新的 Scaling 轴，预训练加强化学习或许足以实现 AGI，无需新突破。

sholto.en: Agent reliability, measured by success rate over time horizon, is the bottleneck, not just capability.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他指出智能体的可靠性（以时间跨度内的成功率衡量）才是瓶颈，而不仅仅是能力。

sholto.en: Coding is the leading indicator and most tractable domain; world models are not on the critical path to AGI.
sholto.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他始终认为编程是领先指标和最易突破的领域，而世界模型不在通往 AGI 的关键路径上。

sholto.en: Compute is the new oil; managing fleets of AI agents and orchestration matter more than raw intelligence for now.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他提出算力是新石油，当前管理 AI 智能体集群和编排比原始智能更重要。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training with RLHF and inference-time algorithms matter more; scaling alone won't yield common sense.
yejin.zh: 2023 年她强调：预训练带来广度，但后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与推理期算法更关键；单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

yejin.en: Persistent thread: data is the bottleneck; smaller models with better data and algorithms can rival larger ones.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 一以贯之的主线：数据才是瓶颈；用更好的数据与算法，小模型也能比肩大模型。

yejin.en: Shifts focus to synthetic data and RLVR; warns current AI only interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
yejin.zh: 2025 年转向合成数据与 RLVR，并警示当前 AI 只是对人类知识的插值，而非超越。

yejin.en: Deepens on reinforcement learning: as pre-training objective it is costly but yields lasting reasoning gains.
yejin.zh: 2025 到 2026 年深化对强化学习的思考：作为预训练目标代价高昂，却带来持久的推理收益。

yejin.en: Embraces pluralistic alignment and open small models, rejecting debiasing the internet as impossible.
yejin.zh: 2026 年主张多元对齐与开放小模型，认为净化互联网不可行，多元对齐才是出路。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must feel fast, familiar, and require zero learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计师应当写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; use familiar patterns for speed, and chase ROI rather than perfecting every surface.
henrymodisett.zh: 不要在交互设计上创新，用熟悉模式换速度；追求投入产出比，而非把每个界面都做到完美。

henrymodisett.en: Design is now a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, not just ship fast.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，设计升级为战略武器；创始人必须讲清设计为何能帮公司取胜，而不只是快速交付。

henrymodisett.en: Brand narrative is a recruiting tool: people join a brand, not a company, so invest in brand early to attract talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 品牌叙事成为招聘工具：人们加入的是品牌而非公司，因此要早早投资品牌以吸引人才。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity and decisiveness stay constant, but ownership deepens: give designers autonomy, adapt process to the problem, and let gut beat data in fast growth.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 到 2026，速度与决断一以贯之，但自主权深化：给设计师所有权、让流程随问题而变，在高速增长中直觉常胜过数据。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems; treat AI as a creative partner and jam openly.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈，引导工程师并对齐问题；将 AI 视为创意伙伴，开放地即兴协作。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and you pay it off iteratively alongside technical debt, maximizing learning through rapid experimentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务：会波动，需与技术债一起迭代偿还，通过快速实验最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: The future of design tools is interoperable, with code as the source of truth; 90s design tools are legacy and AI enables forward progress.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计工具的未来是互操作性，代码作为真相来源；90 年代的设计工具已过时，AI 推动真正进步。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams of designers and engineers outperform cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 填补差距的通才最有价值；设计师与工程师的小团队优于跨职能大团队。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in the early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成为预期；不采用它就像早期忽视互联网一样。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict progress; test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为缩放定律能预测进步，并预言测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练成为主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central, and natural language won't be primary for coding.
truell.zh: 2024 年他指出智能体前景可期但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心，自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式。

truell.en: Custom models became essential for product quality and speed, a shift from earlier reliance on frontier models alone.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他从依赖前沿模型转向认为定制模型对产品质量和速度至关重要。

truell.en: Programming will move from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design matter more.
truell.zh: 2025 年他提出编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图描述，人类仍掌控方向，品味与逻辑设计变得更关键。

truell.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and take decades; incumbents may struggle in this new IDE market.
truell.zh: 2025 年他强调 AI 变革比互联网更深远且需数十年，现有巨头可能在新 IDE 市场中陷入困境。

leike.en: AI safety needs more empirical researchers; talent gap exceeds funding gap, and building skills matters more than avoiding capability work.
leike.zh: 2018 年：AI 安全需要更多实证研究者；人才缺口大于资金缺口，练好技能比回避能力研究更重要。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; scalable oversight and interpretability are needed to align next-gen models.
leike.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人输出；需要可扩展监督与可解释性来对齐下一代模型。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved and compute promises broken, so post-training alone can't align AGI.
leike.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 安全文化受损，超级对齐团队解散、算力承诺未兑现，仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能）。

leike.en: Alignment must be empirically tested and measured; uncertainty about true alignment is the core risk, not misalignment alone.
leike.zh: 始终：对齐必须经过实证测试与度量；真正的核心风险是对系统是否对齐的不确定性，而非错位本身。

shazeer.en: LLMs are trained on next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though neural nets remain opaque.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为大语言模型基于下一个词预测训练，这是一个 AI 完全问题；通过更多算力和数据的 Scaling（规模扩张）能让 AI 更聪明，但神经网络内部仍不透明。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are major near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他提出推理时算力扩展和更长上下文窗口是近期重大机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构能实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial, and AGI is underhyped.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他强调测试时算力扩展能推动进步但无法单独实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力和强化学习至关重要，且 AGI 被低估。

shazeer.en: Scaling compute and data is the core driver of AI progress, from pre-training to inference-time compute scaling.
shazeer.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：算力和数据的 Scaling（规模扩张）是 AI 进步的核心驱动力，从预训练到推理时算力扩展一以贯之。

shazeer.en: From focusing on next-token prediction and Transformer to emphasizing inference-time compute, agentic capabilities, and reinforcement learning for reasoning.
shazeer.zh: 从 2023 年关注下一个词预测和 Transformer，到 2025 年深化为强调推理时算力、智能体式能力和强化学习提升推理，思考不断深化。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; current RL lacks it, but self-play and imitation learning offer strong signals.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他认为机器人需要分层推理来解决长时程信用分配问题，但当前强化学习缺乏这一能力；自对弈和模仿学习能提供强信号。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus RL boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded; pre-trained language models transfer reasoning to non-language tasks.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他主张无监督学习与强化学习结合可大幅提升样本效率；先验知识应用于数据增强而非硬编码；预训练语言模型能将推理模式迁移到非语言任务。

abbeel.en: Consistently emphasizes transfer learning via fine-tuning large pre-trained models, from robotics to language models, as a major AI success.
abbeel.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年，他始终强调通过微调大型预训练模型进行迁移学习是 AI 的重大成功，从机器人领域延伸到语言模型。

abbeel.en: Deepened view: a single neural network can generalize across warehouse tasks and end effectors, moving beyond task-specific hard-coding.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年观点深化：单个神经网络可泛化到不同仓库任务和末端执行器，超越了针对特定任务的硬编码。
